jobs.title: IT Program Manager, Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
As a Manager in the Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US) Office of the CIO (OCIO) PMO team you will play a key role in support of the PMO and the use of project management practices and methodologies across DT-US to enable world-class delivery of our firm's internal technology programs.

The DT-US PMO team is part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO) and reports to the US OCIO Leader. The OCIO leads the development and implementation for technology strategy at Deloitte and drives the strategic initiatives to build market leading technology capabilities. DT-US powers IT for Deloitte's 175K+ professionals while supporting business priorities and transformational initiatives in areas such as AI, Cloud, and Cyber.

Recruiting for this role ends on December 31st 2026.

Work you'll do

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will lead the PMO Operations team and own the processes, tools, and reporting that give DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership timely insight into portfolio status, risks, and issues. You will serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability across program management, and maintain the reusable templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed. You will also be available to step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.

As the DT-US PMO Operations Manager, you will build and demonstrate strong competency and business knowledge across PMO Operations. As the sole leader of the Operations team, you are accountable for team direction, coaching, performance feedback, and overall PMO service quality. This includes managing the team's budget and resource assignments, leading performance management, and overseeing training and certification requirements.

Responsibilities include:

Team Leadership: Lead and manage the PMO Operations team as its sole leader, providing direction, coaching, and performance feedback, and owning overall team service quality.
Budget & Resource Management: Analyze the PMO Operations budget and manage resource assignments across the team to ensure appropriate coverage across programs.
Performance Management: Own the performance management cycle for the PMO team.
Learning & Development: Identify learning & development opportunities and manage certification requirements (e.g., PMP) for the PMO team.
Team Communications & Events: Own recurring PMO team communications, including monthly all-hands meetings and any in-person team events.
Portfolio Reporting & Insight: Own portfolio-level reporting, working with program managers to deliver timely, accurate insight into program status, risks, dependencies, and decisions to DT-US service area leaders and PMO leadership.
Governance Support: Maintain PMO governance standards and processes that support consistent program and project delivery across DT-US.
ServiceNow SPM Process Ownership: Serve as the process owner and administrator for the ServiceNow SPM module, with elevated access to configure, maintain, and evolve PMO's use of the platform.
AI & Automation: Design AI and automation solutions that create efficiency and repeatability in program management, including reporting, planning, and knowledge management.
Reusable PM Assets: Develop and maintain the templates, tools, and governance frameworks PMO makes available to teams across DT-US where PMO is not directly deployed.
Short-Term Critical Support: Step into short-term, critical needs across DT-US to help teams stand up program and project management processes and tooling.
Process Improvement: Evaluate current PMO processes and recommend improvements to increase team efficiency and effectiveness.
Stakeholder Interaction: Interact with senior leaders, prepare presentations on PMO strategy and performance, and manage stakeholder relationships.
Quality Management: Evaluate and maintain quality management standards within the PMO.
Travel Requirements: Ability to travel 0-10%, predominantly remote with the option of working from home or a nearby Deloitte office.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

Required Qualifications:

6+ years of relevant experience in Project/Program Management working on large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives utilizing a structured project management methodology and formal tools/approaches (PMBOK, Prince2, etc)
3+ years of experience managing full lifecycle IT projects including overseeing the strategy / business case development, developing the implementation plan to support the business case, and driving the implementation of the plan to deliver the final program objectives
Recent experience using generative AI tools (e.g., prompt design, workflow automation) to improve program reporting, documentation, or process efficiency

1+ year of people/process management experience including but not limited to overseeing and mentoring numerous other PMs, Project Coordinators, etc.
3+ years of project / program financial management (e.g., Planning, Forecasting, Budgeting, Business Case Development, etc.) in addition to experience in the planning, estimation, resource management, project tracking, scope control, risk and issues management as well as stakeholder relationship management.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration or equivalent educational and/or equivalent relevant professional experience
Ability to travel 0-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve; this role is predominantly remote with the option to work from home or a nearby Deloitte office
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred Qualifications:

PMP Certification
1+ year of SPM module administration experience
Experience working with MS Planner Plan 3 is highly preferred
Minimum of 1 year of experience in a matrixed professional services firm OR consulting
Strategic and critical thinker with the ability to make connections across programs and logically structure issues and determine recommended resolutions
Excellent written and verbal communications skills and strong executive presence.
Strong MS PowerPoint skills with proven record of creating high impact, audience-specific presentations.
Self-starter comfortable taking the lead and managing multiple initiatives with an ability to effectively collaborate across teams
Detail-oriented with ability to plan, prioritize, and make decisions on multiple projects

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $102,500-$171,000.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Cloudflare, DataDome, or comparable bot-management and web application protection platforms, including leading bot mitigation or traffic-quality programs.
Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.
Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure, transitioning systems from external vendors, and consolidating cloud accounts or IT services.
Familiarity with privacy requirements and secure handling of sensitive consumer data.
Experience building or maturing SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering functions.

Measures of Success

Improved availability, performance, and stability of customer-facing platforms.
Reduced impact and infrastructure costs associated with bots, scraping, and automated abuse.
Faster incident detection, response, and recovery, alongside a reduction in recurring incidents.
Enhanced observability with reduced alert noise, validated disaster recovery capabilities, and optimized cloud spend.
Consistent helpdesk performance, reliable onboarding and offboarding, and robust endpoint security and asset tracking.
Strong architecture governance, reduced dependency on undocumented systems or vendors, and demonstrated team development.

Compensation and Benefits

Annual base salary: $170,000 - $180,000

Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
Life insurance
Retirement benefits with employer match

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We are seeking a transformative security leader who can evolve Slack's security posture from protecting a messaging platform to securing an AI work OS where autonomous agents are first-class actors. As Senior Director of Security Engineering, you will lead a globally distributed security organization and own the full spectrum — from platform defense and incident response through product security, identity, and the emerging discipline of AI/agent security. You'll partner across Slack and Salesforce to ensure Slack remains the most trusted platform for both human users and the autonomous AI agents they deploy. This is not a maintenance role. We need someone who sees around corners, builds teams that move faster than adversaries, and has the conviction to drive a security program that's as forward-looking as the product it protects.

What You'll Build (Transform)

Architect security for the agentic era — Define and execute the end-to-end security vision and roadmap for Slack. You will continuously evolve our security posture to stay ahead of sophisticated, AI-driven threat actors by establishing a complete security model for AI agents operating on Slack with clear benchmarks, driving accountability, and aligning platform defense with broader enterprise business goals. Evolve Slack’s identity and access management to consider emerging zero trust agentic use cases
Build AI-powered defense capabilities — Evolve our AI and ML-driven detection, threat hunting, and automated response systems that stay ahead of the AI-augmented adversaries doubling down on proactive, autonomous threat detection that leverages LLMs to correlate signals across Slack's infrastructure at machine speed
Transform the SDLC security model — Evolve from gate-based security reviews to security-as-code that makes the safe path the easy path for every engineer — including AI coding agents

What You'll Run (Operate)

Own and execute the end-to-end Slack Security program across Platform Defense, Product Security, Infrastructure Protection, IAM, Vulnerability Management, and Security Incident Response
Lead and scale a globally distributed security engineering organization, hiring, developing and retaining top talent including senior security leaders and senior level ICs
Serve as Incident Commander for critical security incidents, providing strategic counsel to executive leadership and ensuring efficient recovery with thorough post-incident learning
Collaborate closely with executive peers across Product, Engineering, Legal, and cross-functional security groups to champion Slack Security, ensuring Slack remains the most trusted and secure platform for users and autonomous AI agents alike.
Proactively benchmark Slack's security posture against industry peers and establish Slack Security as a world-class program that the industry looks to as a reference
Cultivate a security culture across the broader engineering org — making every engineer a security partner through training, tooling, and incentive alignment

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years of broad cybersecurity experience spanning multiple security domains (infrastructure security, application security, incident response, identity, threat intelligence), with at least 8+ years in senior leadership roles managing managers and coaching senior leaders
Proven track record building and scaling enterprise security programs at consumer or enterprise SaaS scale — not just running existing programs, but transforming them in response to fundamental shifts in the threat landscape
Deep expertise in crisis management and incident response, with demonstrated experience leading remediation of major incidents across both product and enterprise environments
Experience leading through organizational change — uniting globally distributed, cross-functional teams into a cohesive, high-performing security culture
Technical depth combined with strategic versatility — comfortable shifting between board-level security strategy and hands-on architecture reviews
Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience driving alignment across Product, Engineering, Legal, and Compliance without direct authority over all parties
A related technical degree required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience securing AI/ML systems, LLM-powered features, or agentic platforms — including threat modeling for prompt injection, tool-use authorization, agent data access, and AI supply chain risks
Track record deploying AI/ML for defensive security — automated threat detection, LLM-assisted threat hunting, anomaly detection at scale, or autonomous incident response
Experience with high-assurance compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP High and DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5), ideally in a product that had to maintain velocity while meeting these bars
Deep familiarity with threat intelligence methodologies and active threat actor TTPs in the tech industry, with experience leading investigations to evict sophisticated threat actors from complex distributed environments
Experience securing platform ecosystems where third-party developers, integrations, or agents extend the attack surface beyond your direct control
Recognized thought leader in the security community — conference speaker, published researcher, or contributor to security standards and frameworks

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data Engineering - Slack
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

AI agents — both the ones we ship to customers and the ones our engineers use to build Slack — are fundamentally changing how data gets created, queried, and acted upon. We are seeking a leader who can transform our data engineering stack from a traditional analytics platform into the foundation for agentic analytics (AI agents that autonomously explore, analyze, and surface insights from data) and agentic development (AI-powered engineering tools that use data infrastructure as their backbone).

As Senior Director of Data Engineering, you will lead a ~40-person organization and own the full data engineering stack — from infrastructure and ingestion through to data products, semantic layers, and AI-facing data services. You'll partner closely with Data Science & Analytics as a strategic peer while driving a bold technical vision: making Slack's data platform the best-in-class substrate for both human analysts and AI agents. This is not a maintenance role. We're looking for someone who sees the agentic future of data platforms and wants to build it.

What You'll Build (Transform)

Architect the data layers agents rely on— Design and ship data APIs, MCP servers, and semantic interfaces that let AI agents (Slackbot AI, internal coding agents, customer-built Agentforce agents) query, reason over, and act on Slack's data autonomously
Transform the semantic layer — Evolve our metrics platform from a human-query tool into a machine-readable knowledge that agents can navigate, with governed metric definitions, lineage, and natural-language access patterns
Build real-time data products — Move beyond batch analytics to streaming data infrastructure that supports sub-second agent decision-making, real-time experimentation, and low-latency retrieval
Ship agentic analytics tooling — Create the next generation of self-serve analytics where AI agents draft queries, detect anomalies, generate insights, and surface recommendations — replacing manual dashboard-watching with proactive, agent-driven intelligence
Establish AI-native observability — Instrument the data stack with LLM-aware tracing (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions), token/cost attribution, and quality metrics that treat AI agents as first-class consumers of data infrastructure
Drive the Data MCP strategy — Own the vision for how Slack's data warehouse, metrics layer, and analytics tools are exposed to AI agents via MCP servers, making Slack's data the most agent-accessible enterprise dataset in the industry

What You'll Run (Operate)

Own and unify the Data Engineering roadmap across infrastructure, ingestion, data governance, tooling, semantic layer sub-teams
Serve as the DRI for data engineering, representing data engineering in leadership planning and resolving cross-team priority conflicts
Partner directly with the Data Science & Analytics organization — establishing and running an effective operating model
Set data freshness SLAs, warehouse reliability, and cost optimization standards across ingestion and infrastructure teams and ensure the data platform meets those standards and goals
Build and scale engineering capacity — hire, develop and retain top EM and senior IC talents
Champion a strong data engineering identity and culture
Partner with product, infrastructure, and DevXP leadership on cross-cutting initiatives

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform, or infrastructure engineering roles, including 5+ years in engineering leadership at the Director level or above
Proven track record building and scaling data platforms (ingestion pipelines, warehousing, semantic/metrics layers) at consumer or enterprise SaaS scale
Experience leading through organizational change — team consolidations, re-orgs, or multi-team integrations
Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science / Analytics leadership as a peer stakeholder
Strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior ICs
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with experience presenting technical vision and strategy to executive stakeholders
A related technical degree required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads — not just dashboards and reports, but data infrastructure optimized for model training, feature serving, RAG retrieval, or agent-driven queries
Hands-on understanding of how LLMs and AI agents consume data — including semantic layers, embeddings, vector search, tool-use patterns (MCP, function calling), and structured vs. unstructured data access
Experience with agentic systems, AI-assisted analytics, or building developer tools powered by AI (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated data quality, natural-language-to-SQL)
Track record shipping data-as-a-product — APIs, SDKs, or self-serve platforms where internal or external developers are the primary consumers
Experience operating a "pod" or embedded working model that pairs engineering with data science/analytics
Familiarity with modern data stack components: warehouse infrastructure, streaming ingestion, semantic/metrics layers (governance, OLAP systems, Airflow-like orchestration)
Experience running experimentation platforms and A/B testing infrastructure at scale

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Sinclair Digital is seeking a highly experienced Principal Program Manager to lead complex, high\-impact initiatives across digital product, technology, and business teams. jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Whole Foods Market Central Kitchen Strategy, Whole Foods Market Culinary Merchandising
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Whole Foods Market is seeking a Principal Program Manager to help shape the future of how we produce freshly prepared food in centralized commissary kitchens. This is a strategic, senior role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can define strategy where little exists today. Working across Amazon VP organizations and with senior leadership at WFM and Amazon, you will lead a significant, complex initiative from concept through execution, building the business case, aligning stakeholders, and standing up the mechanisms needed to deliver. The ideal candidate pairs deep strategic program management experience with a strong understanding of food service, kitchen production, supply chain, food safety, and multi\-unit retail operations, and can influence and align senior leaders across culinary merchandising, supply chain, operations, finance, and technology.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the vision, strategy, and multi\-year roadmap for a significant, complex initiative, driving clarity where the business problem and strategy are not yet fully defined.
* Build out business cases and financial plans, framing capital, operational, and strategic tradeoffs for senior leaders and grounding recommendations in data.
* Partner across merchandising, supply chain, operations, quality assurance and food safety, finance, technology, and other functional teams to align the organization on a coherent operating model and clear ownership.
* Establish the planning, forecasting, and performance mechanisms needed to run the program and measure its success.
* Design and launch pilots to validate our strategy, including clear learning plans, and create the stage gates that govern how and when the program scales.
* Prepare and drive executive\-ready reviews, business cases, and PR/FAQ and narrative documents, representing complex decisions and tradeoffs clearly to VPs and, when needed, SVPs.
* Identify and mitigate program risks, building in the redundancy and contingency needed to protect continuity of service to stores and customers.
* Actively develop the program management community through mentoring, promotion assessments, and best\-practice sharing.
* Travel Requirements: Approximately 30% travel to facilities, stores, and partner sites may be required.

  

About the team  

Our team is at the heart of transforming how customers experience fresh, prepared food at Whole Foods Market and Worldwide Grocery Stores. We set the category strategy and define production models that shape what lands on shelves and in shopping baskets across hundreds of stores nationwide. We work at the intersection of food, data, operations, and retail, partnering closely with supply chain, private brands, operations, e\-commerce, finance, and technology to bring innovative, high\-quality food programs to life. Our culture rewards curiosity, deep ownership, and creative problem\-solving. If you are energized by building something new that directly shapes what customers eat every day, this is the team for you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of program or project management experience
* 7\+ years of managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience owning program strategy and end to end delivery
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience in food production
* Deep knowledge of food production and kitchen operations, supply chain and distribution, and the associated food safety and regulatory controls.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience delivering projects within scope, time, budget and quality
* MBA
* Experience working in a physical store
* Experience designing or scaling fresh food production and distribution networks.
* Working knowledge of food safety systems (HACCP), allergen and labeling requirements, and quality assurance at scale.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

**About the Role**


Reporting to the GM – Technology, the purpose of the Head of Technology is to run Eco Outdoor's technology operations and delivery day to day, so our systems, vendors and projects keep pace with a business growing quickly across the US, Australia, and New Zealand.


This role keeps our core platforms and partners (Salesforce, NetSuite, website and IT managed service providers) reliable and well supported, delivers technology projects on time and on budget, and builds a function that can scale shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the business. The Head of Technology partners closely with the GM Technology as a genuine deputy, and with leaders across Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, People \& Culture, Product, and Finance in both the US and Australia.


The role is based in the United States (**on\-site/hybrid, Los Angeles, CA**). The working schedule is **10:00am – 6:00pm (Pacific Time), Monday to Friday**. jobs.description:
**Job Function Summary**

Involves managing a significant, independent academic or research program. Formulates program strategies and goals. Plans, directs and controls program budget and other related resources.


**Generic Scope**

Spends the majority of time (50% or more) achieving organizational objectives through the coordinated achievements of subordinate staff. Establishes departmental goals and objectives, functions with autonomy. Manages the accountability and stewardship of human, financial, and often physical resources in compliance with departmental and organizational goals and objectives. Ensures subordinate supervisors and professionals adhere to defined internal controls. Manages systems and procedures to protect departmental assets.


**Custom Scope**

Independently manages and provides technical direction in conjunction with faculty director for a complex academic or research program of high visibility. Develops the long\-term vision and goals, policies and procedures, as well as managing ongoing operations of program(s) and oversees a fairly large operational budget to achieve objectives. Responsible for recruiting and retaining industry leaders to partner with research program in achievement of center goals. Develops and manages a membership program for industry partners. Oversees, through subordinate Academic Program Management Officers, all strategic elements of program administration including establishing program partners. Uses highly specialized expertise in research or academic specific concepts and objectives.


Under general direction of the QBI Director, the Director, QBI\-Oncology and Development Strategy establishes, directs, and sustains QBI's oncology research and partnership enterprise. Receives assignments in the form of broad institutional objectives and determines the strategy, methods, and resources required to achieve them. Formulates program policy, priorities, and operating standards for the oncology portfolio.


Holds primary accountability for the program's strategic direction, financial sustainability, personnel, and external partnerships. Secures multi\-year funding from philanthropic, federal, and industry sources. Originates and negotiates industry\-sponsored research agreements and multi\-year research collaborations and advances them through applicable University approval and execution processes. Recruits, supervises, and develops scientific and program staff. Manages program budget and allocates resources across a multi\-project portfolio.


The Oncology and Devt. The Director independently evaluates opportunities, establishes partnership priorities, and makes recommendations regarding portfolio direction and resource allocation, exercising substantial judgment in matters involving scientific strategy, financial investment, institutional priorities, and external relationships. The Director advises QBI executive leadership on oncology portfolio strategy, investment, and growth and serves as QBI’s principal program representative in strategic partnership discussions involving significant financial, scientific, and reputational considerations for the University.


The Director is responsible for building a durable, high\-impact oncology enterprise that advances QBI’s scientific mission, expands its external partnerships and funding base, and creates opportunities for translational research and development.

**Who We Are**

Established in 2016 the Quantitative Biosciences Institute (QBI) is a world class institution focused on breakthrough scientific discoveries and medical treatments based upon highly innovative science and on diverse global cross\-sector partnerships, conducted at an unprecedented scale. The institute is comprised of 139 affiliated laboratories. QBI also boasts a robust media, outreach and events presence as the glue that brings all the programs and people together.


**What We Do**

We are transforming the way science is done by creating and supporting collaborative cross\-functional groups who work towards solving some of today’s biggest scientific challenges. QBI has a successful track record in high impact scientific accomplishment and in securing multi\-million dollar grants. QBI and UCSF are pioneering a new model of translating science into medicines that fully leverages complementary knowledge and expertise between academia and industry.


**How We Work**

We work to transform the way science is done. The institute also passionately believes in building a more equitable scientific environment across the globe and toward this goal has built partnerships around the world including in the US, Europe, Africa, China and the Caribbean. We are a very competitive team, and the phrase “not my job”, is not in our philosophy nor in our vocabulary. We believe in working together in\-person at the office to foster a culture of creativity and collaboration. As we expand, we continue to look for people who have the ability to think outside the box.


**About the existing QBI Team**

The QBI team responsibilities range from running the operations of the institute to managing specific science projects and programs. We have people who focus on advocacy, industry relations, international collaborations and the coordination of matching different labs with financial opportunities to work together.

* Demonstrated experience directing research programs and establishing scientific and strategic direction independently.
* Demonstrated experience in commercial or investment assessment of biomedical assets, including scientific di

Where assigned as a Technology Asset Owner (TAO) or supporting a TAO function, this role will also help ensure technology assets are accurately registered, maintained, governed, and managed through their lifecycle.

Morgan, Lewis & Bockius LLP, one of the world’s leading global law firms with offices in strategic hubs of commerce, law, and government across North America, Asia, Europe, and the Middle East, is seeking to hire a Senior Manager, Technology Enablement.

The Senior Manager, Technology Enablement, serves as the business owner for the Practice Group's technology portfolio, ensuring the technology investments are effectively operationalized, adopted, optimized, and translated into measurable business value.

This role functions as an internal strategic consultant responsible for identifying operational opportunities, improving service delivery, leading enterprise initiatives, and maximizing the return on the Practice Group's technology investments.

Unlike traditional technology leadership positions focused on engineering or platform development, this role focuses on business enablement ensuring technology capabilities are fully leveraged through process optimization, stakeholder alignment, client engagement, operational consulting, and continuous improvement.

The Senior Manager partners directly with attorneys, clients, executive leadership, and operational teams to evaluate business needs, identify organizational blind spots, improve technology adoption, develop scalable service offerings, and lead strategic initiatives from concept through implementation.

Success in this position requires exceptional consulting, communication, operational strategy, project leadership, and change management skills, combined with deep experience within legal technology, eDiscovery, and professional services environments.

Strategic Business Consulting

The Chief Information Officer is accountable for the strategy, security, stability, architecture, and performance of ACCC's technology environment. This leader translates business priorities into a disciplined technology roadmap, protects client and organizational data, strengthens the reliability and recoverability of critical systems, and builds an operating model that delivers measurable business value. The CIO leads Information Technology and serves as the senior technology advisor to the Chief Operating Officer, Chief Executive Officer, Executive Leadership Team, and Board as requested.


The role requires a hands\-on and strategic leader who can stabilize current operations while modernizing legacy platforms, improving delivery discipline, strengthening vendor accountability, and developing a capable technology team. Job Description

Your Role

The Technology team is responsible for the delivery, operation, and governance of secure, compliant, and scalable platforms that support critical healthcare services and enable the successful separation and long-term independence of the Ascendiun family of companies. The Director, Technology Transformation will report to the Chief Information Officer (CIO). In this role you will for lead cross-functional teams to deliver large-scale programs that create sustainable, systematic improvements across technology and business operations.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Responsibilities

Your Work

In this role, you will:

Lead strategic technology initiatives that improve operational performance, scalability, reliability, and customer experience.
Identify systemic challenges and drive sustainable solutions that address root causes rather than symptoms.
Develop and execute transformation roadmaps aligned with business objectives and technology strategy.
Partner with business and technology leaders to drive organizational change and process improvements.
Lead complex, cross-functional technology programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and delivery teams.
Establish governance, milestones, success metrics, and reporting mechanisms to ensure program success.
Drive prioritization, issue resolution, risk management, and decision-making across initiatives.
Ensure projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business outcomes.
Lead efforts to improve system stability, service performance, operational maturity, and supportability.
Facilitate root-cause analysis and corrective action planning for recurring issues.
Build strong partnerships with business leaders, product owners, and technology teams.
Communicate program status, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Your Knowledge and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
Requires a minimum of 10 years of technology experience, including 6+ years in leadership roles managing enterprise technology initiatives.
Proven experience leading large-scale technology programs and transformational initiatives.
Strong understanding of enterprise applications, infrastructure, cloud technologies, and operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
Experience managing complex stakeholder environments and balancing competing priorities.

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

About Us

About Stellarus and the Ascendiun Family of Companies

Stellarus, launched in January 2025, is designed to scale innovative healthcare solutions that support customers in creating a health care experience deserving of their family, friends, and neighbors.

Stellarus is part of a family of organizations that is overseen by a nonprofit corporate entity named Ascendiun. The Ascendiun Family of Companies also includes Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan and Altais, a clinical services company.

Stellarus’ vision is to empower its customers to create a healthcare experience that is worthy of their family, friends, and neighbors. Stellarus’ objective is to offer innovative, modern, scalable solutions that challenge the health care status quo. This very closely aligns with Blue Shield of California’s vision by using innovation to improve quality, affordability, and experience for members.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

Our Values:

At Stellarus, our core values of agility, trust, drive, courage and service shape our approach to developing innovative product offerings.

Our Workplace Model:

We believe in fostering a workplace environment that balances purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility - providing clear expectations while respecting the diverse needs of our workforce. Our workplace model is designed around intentional in-person interaction, collaboration, connection, creativity and flexibility:

For most teams, this means coming into the office two days per week.
Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location, out of state employees, and employees in certain member-facing roles should work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.
For employees with medical conditions that may impact their ability to work in-office, we are committed to engaging in an interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to ensure their work environment is conducive to their success and well-being.

The Company reserves the right to require more presence in the office based on business needs, and requirements are subject to change with periodic reviews.

Physical Requirements:

Office Environment - roles involving part to full time schedule in Office Environment. Based in our physical offices and work from home office/deskwork - Activity level: Sedentary, frequency most of work day.

jobs.description:
**THIS IS A NON\-CIVIL SERVICE POSITION**

**Salary Range:**

***$122,569\.00 \- $202,068\.00 Annually***

**Get to Know Us**

Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD\&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr\-divisions/benefits


**Job Summary**

The Director, Infrastructure serves as the senior leader responsible for the reliability, security, and performance of Baltimore City’s enterprise technology environment, overseeing data centers, network and cloud infrastructure, Service Desk operations, desktop support, storage, and email services. This role drives the City’s hybrid cloud strategy, ensures 24/7 operational continuity, strengthens cybersecurity in partnership with the CISO, and leads modernization efforts that support agency operations citywide. The Director provides strategic planning, budget oversight, vendor and contract management, and cross‑functional leadership to ensure Baltimore’s technology foundation is resilient, cost‑effective, and aligned with long‑term IT priorities.


**Essential Functions**

**Leadership \& People Management**

* Lead all supervisory functions: recruiting, hiring, staffing plans, performance management, training, conflict resolution, and corrective actions.
* Represent BCIT to senior leadership, delivering regular updates on infrastructure performance, key projects, and issue resolution.
* Build a culture of collaboration and shared accountability—no finger\-pointing, just problem\-solving.
**Infrastructure Operations**

* Ensure 24/7 reliability through system monitoring, backups, performance tuning, patching, and OS upgrades across all platforms.
* Manage internet and network infrastructure, including firewall administration and around\-the\-clock connectivity support.
* Direct Service Desk and desktop support to achieve high first\-call resolution rates and effective ticket escalation.
* Administer on\-call schedules and participate in rotation as needed.
**Security \& Resilience**

* Partner with the CISO and security teams to align infrastructure operations with the City’s cybersecurity strategy, ensuring network, endpoint, and data center environments meet current standards and compliance requirements.
* Drive improvement of securing the infrastructure—including network segmentation, least\-privilege access controls, and multi\-factor authentication—to reduce the City’s attack surface and limit the impact of any security incident.
* Lead infrastructure\-level preparedness for cyber threats, including ransomware response planning, regular tabletop exercises, and ensuring backup and recovery systems are isolated, tested, and ready to execute.
**Strategy \& Planning**

* Develop infrastructure roadmaps and strategies aligned with agency needs and the City’s long\-term technology vision.
* Own the City’s hybrid cloud infrastructure strategy—defining standards for workload placement, managing cloud provider relationships, and ensuring on\-premise and cloud environments are integrated, secure, and cost\-effective.
* Drive cloud cost optimization across the infrastructure portfolio, establishing governance around cloud spend, rightsizing resources, and identifying opportunities to consolidate or migrate workloads to reduce total cost of ownership.
* Contribute to annual operating and capital budget planning; manage assigned budget with full accountability.
* Participate in enterprise\-wide strategic planning and multi\-agency IT initiatives.
* Monitor emerging technology trends and integrate best practices to continuously advance BCIT’s capabilities.
**Procurement \& Contract Management**

* Cultivate vendor relationships to maximize value from partner products and services.
* Review citywide technology purchase requests to ensure compliance with BCIT standards and IT strategy.
* Manage hardware and software procurement within budget, with proper justification and approval documentation.
* Oversee infrastructure contracts: enforce terms, prevent unintended auto\-renewals, and approve monthly invoices for leases, maintenance, and services.
**Architecture \& Service Delivery**

* Develop and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that set clear performance expectations for end users.
* Partner with development teams and user groups to design effective IT architecture and drive timely issue resolution.
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date asset inventory for all BCIT technology assets.
**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:** Have a bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline preferred.


Relevant certifications are a plus: Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer (MCSE), Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), AWS Solutions Architect, or Microsoft Azure Administrator.


Prior IT experience in a government environment is strongly preferred.


**OR**

**Equivalency Notes:** Have an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. If a degree is unrelated to IT, specialized IT experience is required. Advanced technical certifications may substitute for up to six months of experienc

Company Description
Alfa Capital Management is a premier capital management firm that delivers high-quality financial services to individual and institutional clients with a focus on precision, innovation, and integrity. The firm offers a broad range of services, including investment and portfolio management, hedge fund solutions, wealth management, financial advisory, and private equity and alternative investment opportunities. Alfa Capital Management combines traditional investment principles with advanced quantitative models and analytics to design data-driven, high-performance strategies. With a disciplined, research-driven approach, the firm emphasizes personalized investment strategies, quantitative risk management, strategic asset allocation, and dynamic portfolio optimization. Its mission is to empower clients through intelligent capital management solutions that support sustainable wealth creation and long-term financial security.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology is a full-time remote role responsible for leading the firm’s overall technology vision, strategy, and execution. This role oversees the design, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support investment management, quantitative research, analytics, and client services. Day-to-day responsibilities include directing IT strategy, managing technology roadmaps, supervising project delivery, and ensuring systems are secure, scalable, and compliant with industry regulations. The Vice President of Technology collaborates closely with executive leadership, investment teams, and operations to align technology initiatives with business goals and to drive innovation in data management, automation, and digital client experiences. This role also leads and mentors technology teams, manages vendor relationships, and continuously evaluates emerging tools and architectures to enhance operational efficiency and performance.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret complex data, support quantitative research, and guide technology decisions.
Candidates should possess deep Information Technology expertise, including enterprise systems, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and data management.
Candidates should possess IT Strategy experience, with a track record of defining technology roadmaps that align with organizational objectives.
Candidates should possess Project Management capabilities to oversee multiple initiatives, manage timelines and budgets, and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Candidates should possess Strategic Planning skills to connect technology investments with long-term business growth and operational resilience.
Extensive leadership experience in technology roles within financial services, asset management, or fintech is highly beneficial.
Experience with quantitative platforms, trading systems, analytics tools, and data governance frameworks is a strong advantage.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, CISSP, CFA Institute-related programs) are preferred.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and remote team leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and time zones.

jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

  

**This is a Non\-Classified position, performing the outlined duties with the Auraria Higher Education Center.**  

  

**Who we are:**
Welcome to the **Auraria Campus located** in the Platte River Valley in downtown Denver. The Auraria Campus is the service provider for 38,000 students and approximately 5000 faculty and staff working at and attending the **Community College of Denver, Metropolitan State University of Denver,** and the **University of Colorado Denver**. Learn more about us through this link: The Auraria Campus
  

  

Auraria employees enjoy an excellent benefits package which includes paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave, multiple medical, dental and vision options, discounted RTD Eco\-Pass, BenefitHub and outstanding retirement plan. Learn more through this link: Non\-Classified Benefits Package.
   

  

So, if you're interested in a great job working alongside great people, this may be the opportunity for which you've been waiting for.
  

**Description of Job**
----------------------


**Job Summary:**
Reporting to the Director of Strategy, and working closely with the Information Technology Department, the Technical Program Manager leads enterprise\-wide and departmental technology initiatives within AHEC’s Strategy department. This role manages multiple concurrent projects, partnering with technical teams, stakeholders, vendors, and leadership to deliver technology solutions that advance institutional goals. The role develops and executes project plans, manages risk, facilitates decision making, and communicates effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences within a cloud\-forward, vendor\-integrated, data\-driven environment. This position will manage high visibility, campus\-impacting initiatives, collaborating with technical and functional stakeholders, and vendors to design and implement solutions that advance AHEC’s goals and support success

  

  

**Essential Job Functions:**
**Project Leadership**


* Lead enterprise technology projects including SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, cybersecurity, AV, data, integration, and business process initiatives.
* Develop charters, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk strategies. Coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage vendors, facilitate governance, monitor scope/schedule/budget, resolve issues, and ensure alignment with institutional priorities.
* Leads and coordinate enterprise system migration initiatives, including software implementation, platform consolidation, cloud migration, data migration, system upgrades, and application lifecycle transitions.
* Develop migration roadmaps, piloting and testing, and ensuring successful adoption of new technologies while minimizing operational disruption. Partners with IT and business unit stakeholders to assess technology environments, participating in software and system reviews.
* Identifies operational, cybersecurity, compliance, and business continuity risks.
* Supports the development and implementation of risk mitigation strategies.

**Process Design \& Continuous Improvement (20%)**
* Develop and maintains project management methodologies, standards, templates, and governance practices.
* Develops and maintains project intake, prioritization, reporting, and portfolio management processes.
* Analyze project performance, lessons learned, and organizational practices to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Recommends and implements process improvements to increase project consistency, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Establishes and maintains processes for monitoring the organization’s technology project portfolio.

**Technical Trainer (10%)**
* Educate employees or clients on how to use computer hardware, software applications, and internal technical systems.
* Coordinates and delivers training to affected employees and stakeholders during technology implementations.
* Teach cyber security policies, hardware setup, and software updates.
* Develops user guides, procedures, and other learning materials to support adoption of new technology.
* Assesses user readiness and identifies training needs associated with technology implementations.
* Evaluates training effectiveness and modifies materials based on user feedback and project needs.
* Maintain records of completed training and update curricula over time.

**Communication \& Change Management (10 %)**
* Translate complex technical information into dashboards, status reports, executive summaries, presentations, stakeholder communications, and change management plans.
* Facilitate meetings and ensure organizational readiness and adoption.
* Support efforts to align project and business analysis approaches with AHEC leadership expectations and needs.
* Facilitates communication between technical and functional teams by communicating effectively across diverse audiences, including executives, business partners, and technical specialists.
* Skilled at simplifying complex technical topics and presenting them in a way that enables non\-technical stakeholders to understand implications, make informed decisions, and drive results.

**Other Duties as Assigned (5%)**
* Support special initiatives, committees, strategic planning, occasional after\-hours work, and infrequent travel.

jobs.title: Enterprise Resilience Program Manager
jobs.description:
Xcel Energy (NASDAQ: XEL) is a leading energy provider and Fortune 500 company, dedicated to serving millions of electricity and natural gas customers across eight states: Minnesota, Colorado, Wisconsin, Michigan, North Dakota, South Dakota, New Mexico and Texas. We make energy work better for our customers, helping them thrive every day. That means always raising the bar \- delivering better service and providing more reliable, resilient, and sustainable energy.  

  

Xcel Energy is a place where you’ll have opportunities to grow, expand your skills, and help lead the clean energy transition. We offer meaningful rewards, recognition, and support to help you build your career and make an impact \- both on the job and beyond. Most importantly, it means you’ll be joining a company that knows employees are the driving force behind its success and is committed to helping you be your best.

  


Xcel Energy supports a hybrid work model to enable collaboration and flexibility. Many roles are expected to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday–Thursday); however, work location expectations vary based on role, team, and business needs.  

Position Summary  

  

Provide support in the overall program lifecycle for the Company's Enterprise Continuity program. This role will develop plans in support of the Enterprise Continuity program including emergency response processes, business continuity lifecycle management and external partner engagement. Support leadership in improving overall program maturity and measuring progress against industry standards including ISO Standard 22301 \- Organizational Resilience. Provide timely reports to direct leadership and senior leaders. Other duties include leading projects, providing Enterprise Continuity training and awareness to the enterprise, and providing support for the Enterprise Response Center and Business Continuity Management functions.  

  

Essential Responsibilities

  

* Develop metrics and data collection procedures to measure program maturity progress. Generate and analyze timely reports to direct leadership and senior leaders.
* Lead key projects to improve processes and test crisis management and business continuity activities. Keep on top of trends and new methods for improving Enterprise Continuity practices.
* Support the Enterprise Continuity strategic roadmap. Develop plans in support of the overall program including emergency response processes, business continuity lifecycle management and external partner engagement.
* Support maintenance of the Enterprise Continuity services catalog and integrating Enterprise Continuity into the Enterprise Security Services digital presence.
* Provide input on design of existing and new enterprise business continuity and emergency management tools. Work with the Enterprise Response Center and Business Continuity teams to create processes and support ongoing maintenance and communications for the tools.
* Develop, deliver and evaluate continuity and resilience awareness and training across the organization.
* Responsible for supporting implementation of Enterprise Response Center and Business Continuity Management initiatives.
* Coordinate BC exercise requirements to align with standards and continuous improvement of recovery activities.
* Participate in end\-to\-end cyber recovery planning, preparing, and execution activities.
* Support supplier continuity to report to internal business areas, update BC artifacts, and recommend enhancements to the program.

  

Minimum Requirements

  

* Bachelor's Degree and/or equivalent experience.
* At least 5 years of security experience, focus and expertise in incident and crisis management.
* Business Continuity professional certification or ability to obtain within one year.
* Associate Business Continuity Professional (ABCP), Certified, Business Continuity Professional (CBCP), or Member of Business Continuity Institute (MBCI).
* Strong understanding of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery concepts.
* Safety, security, and risk management experience is desirable.
* Excellent planning, organizational, negotiation and client service skills.
* Previous business and/or project experience leading complex initiatives.
* Ability to demonstrate analytical expertise, close attention to detail, excellent critical thinking, logic, and solution orientation and to learn and adapt quickly.
* Strong oral and written communication skills including experience in effective communication with executive leadership.

  

Our culture is grounded in shared values and employee commitments that guide how we work, support one another, and grow together.

 **Our Values**


Connected, Committed, Trustworthy, Safe

 **Our Employee Commitments**

* Work that makes a difference
* A team you can count of
* Opportunities to grow
* Rewards that help you thrive

  

Xcel Energy provides job applicants reasonable accommodations for disabilities throughout the application process. If you are in need of an accommodation to complete the application process, now or at any time in the future, please complete the Applicant Accommodation Request Form.

  

Non\-Bargaining  


The anticipated starting base pay for this position is: $84,900\.00 to $120,566\.66 per year  


This position is eligible for the following benefits: Spot On Bonus, Medical/Pharmacy Plan, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Dependent Care Reimbursement Account, Health Care Reimbursement Account, Health Savings Account (HSA) (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Limited\-Purpose FSA (if enrolled in eligible health plan and HSA), Transportation Reimbursement Account, Short\-term disability (STD), Long\-term disability (LTD), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Fitness Center Reimbursement (if enrolled in eligible health plan), Tuition reimbursement, Transit programs, Employee recognition program, Pension, 401(k) plan, Paid time off (PTO), Holidays, Volunteer Paid Time Off (VPTO), Parental Leave

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
Pandi, LLC
is an SEC-registered investment adviser (“RIA”) and multi-family office based in Kansas City. We provide portfolio management and investment advisory services for families, individuals, trusts, and institutions, including private foundations and private companies owned by our family clients.
Our advisory services primarily consist of: (a) defining overall investment strategy, (b) setting strategic asset allocation targets, (c) selecting, underwriting, and monitoring specific investments, and (d) ensuring our clients have a holistic view of performance for their investment portfolios. We also provide financial consulting and other related family office services to our clients.
The Director of Technology shall define and lead the execution of the technology strategy, cybersecurity posture, and technology operations for Pandi with a focus on leveraging artificial intelligence to automate workflows across investment operations, compliance, reporting, and client service.
This role ensures that information technology systems, infrastructure, and data platforms effectively support business objectives while meeting the operational, security, and regulatory requirements of an SEC-regulated investment firm as well as the needs of its clients’ technology environments. The role combines hands-on technical leadership with strategic oversight of the technology team. In addition to core infrastructure, network, and security responsibilities, the Director will lead the evaluation, governance, and controlled implementation of emerging technologies, including building internal applications and workflows that leverage existing artificial intelligence (“AI”) platforms, while ensuring their use aligns with confidentiality obligations, compliance expectations, and risk tolerance.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Define and execute an organization-wide technology, cybersecurity, data resiliency, and AI strategy that delivers cost-effective, best-in-class services, including governance and risk oversight across Pandi and multiple client entities, including the Patterson Family Foundation and First Hand Foundation.
Serve as a hands-on technology leader by implementing, maintaining, and troubleshooting systems directly while managing, mentoring, and developing the technology team.
Establish and oversee a secure, scalable technology environment leveraging modern cloud productivity, identity, networking, and security platforms to support collaboration, access management, and secure operations in a regulated environment.
Oversee the security of systems, networks, applications, and enterprise data in a cloud-first environment, applying zero-trust architecture and the principle of least privilege across identity, network, and application layers.
Prepare, maintain, and manage annual technology financial plans, including forecasting and cost optimization as well as contract management for technology systems.
Provide regular reporting to Pandi leadership and clients on technology projects, initiatives, security posture, and risks.
Build and maintain data infrastructure—pipelines, warehouses, APIs—that enables advanced analytics and AI integration.
Architect and implement AI-powered workflow automation across core business functions including investment research, portfolio monitoring, compliance reporting, and client communications; stay current on AI developments and proactively identify automation opportunities.
Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster recovery plans, ensuring operational resilience and documented recovery procedures.
Ensure data classification, protection, retention, auditability, and lifecycle management of all enterprise content, including collaboration platforms and AI-enabled systems.
Facilitate and support information technology security audits, reviews, investigations, and ongoing monitoring, leveraging centralized enterprise logging and visibility solutions (e.g., SIEM platforms); continuously improve change management, approval, and documentation processes to ensure controlled, auditable technology changes.
In partnership with the Chief Compliance Officer (CCO), maintain acceptable use standards, data handling requirements, and access controls for effective monitoring and oversight of AI usage; ensure IT operations meet SEC regulatory requirements for registered investment advisers.
Develop and maintain relationships with external information technology vendors and service providers and conduct vendor due diligence and ongoing technology risk assessments.
Promote a culture of thorough documentation, security awareness, accountability, and control discipline; lead effective end-user education and timely security awareness training reinforcing secure behaviors and responsible use of technology and AI tools.

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, or related field; master’s level degree preferred but not required.
Seven (7) or more years of information technology experience with at least five (5) years managing a technology or technical team.
Demonstrated ability to work hands-on: writing code, configuring systems, and solving problems directly.
Experience implementing AI/ML solutions, workflow automation, or data engineering in a business context.
Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, security architecture, and modern enterprise technology platforms.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
Preferred – any relevant certifications.
Preferred – experience supporting SEC-regulated or highly controlled environments (investment advisors, broker-dealers, financial services, etc.).
Preferred – familiarity with investment management and accounting technology platforms (portfolio management, market data providers, custodian integrations, etc.).

jobs.title: IT Program Manager - Clinical Portfolio - Nursing
jobs.description:
We are more than a health system. We are a belief system.
We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary

The IT Program Manager is responsible for leading and managing a team of senior project managers and project managers to successfully deliver a portfolio of work across OhioHealth care sites.

The portfolio of work includes complex, cross functional system implementations, digital transformations, infrastructure modernization, facility expansions, and cybersecurity programs which align to OhioHealth’s strategic goals.

Working closely with care site operational leadership, clinical stakeholders, physicians, vendor partners, and IT leadership, the IT program manager is responsible for management, oversight, and delivery of the full portfolio of projects. This includes staffing allocation and assignment of portfolio work, management of individual contributor project managers, management of interdependencies among projects, and adherence to overall portfolio governance.

The IT Program Manager contributes to the maturity of Solution Delivery organization by identifying opportunities to improve operational efficiency through technology and process optimization. The IT Program Manager hires, mentors and coaches project management staff and provides opportunities for expanded responsibilities to enhance career growth.

This position requires exceptional leadership, verbal and written communication skills, knowledge of the healthcare industry and the ability to influence without direct authority across a large, matrixed organization.

This is Remote-OH position, with required in person meetings.
