jobs.title: VP of IT - Business Applications
jobs.description:
Vice President, IT and Digital Transformation

This is a senior IT and digital transformation leadership role, and it is first and foremost an enterprise applications and ERP leadership role. You will lead technology for a manufacturing business that grew through acquisition and runs multiple independent operating units, each with its own leadership, its own P&L, and in many cases its own systems. The mission is to consolidate and modernize a fragmented applications and ERP landscape, get the underlying data clean and usable, put practical AI to work on top of it, and earn the trust of the business-unit leaders to make it stick. It is a role for a leader who came up through ERP and business applications and wants a career-defining transformation to run.

Compensation:
$250,000 to $285,000 base, plus bonus and long-term incentives.
Logistics:
Remote with travel, US-based

Here's what you'll be doing:

Own the strategy, consolidation, and lifecycle of ERP and enterprise applications across multiple operating businesses, including modernizing legacy and fragmented ERP environments onto a modern, secure, cloud platform.
Lead full-lifecycle ERP work, whether that is standardization, upgrade, migration, or selective consolidation, balancing a unified platform with each business unit's operational needs.
Build the common data layer beneath those applications, driving data cleanup, normalization, and master-data governance so reporting, analytics, and AI have clean, trustworthy data to run on.
Identify and deliver the high-value, practical AI use cases that fit a regulated manufacturing business, from data-layer automation and knowledge retrieval to proposal generation, demand forecasting, and manufacturing workflow.
Operate as a peer to the business-unit leaders who own their P&L, building the relationships and trust needed to align them behind shared standards and carry the work through at the unit level.
Shape the go-forward people and workforce strategy for IT, deciding where to upskill existing teams, hire, or build a shared central capability, and defining the standard for what good looks like at each site.
Keep the business aligned with enterprise security and compliance standards for a regulated environment.
Lead IT due diligence and integration for future acquisitions.

And what you need to have:

A career built in ERP and enterprise business applications, ideally having come up through ERP or applications management before moving into IT leadership.
Hands-on, full-lifecycle ERP experience across implementation, migration, consolidation, or standardization in multi-site or multi-business environments. Oracle strongly preferred (E-Business Suite, Fusion, or Cloud ERP); SAP S/4HANA, Infor, Epicor, or Microsoft Dynamics also valued.
Depth in the enterprise application and data layer: CRM, MES, PLM, integration and middleware, data warehousing, and master-data management, with a record of turning fragmented, disparate systems into a unified, reporting-ready environment.
Practical experience delivering AI or advanced analytics in an industrial or manufacturing setting, with a focus on data quality, automation, and measurable business outcomes.
10+ years of progressive IT leadership in an engineering-centric, product-development, or manufacturing organization operating across multiple sites or business units.
Experience in a highly regulated manufacturing environment, with working familiarity of CMMC, NIST 800-171, DFARS, and ITAR/EAR export controls.
Experience leading IT through M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration.
A proven ability to influence and build trust with autonomous business leaders who own their own P&L, aligning them behind shared standards without relying on direct authority.
Strong business and financial acumen.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA preferred.
US Person status as defined by ITAR is required; ability to obtain and maintain a US security clearance is a plus.
Willingness to travel up to 50% at peak.

No CTC or sponsorship at this time.

Ent Credit Union and Wings Credit Union joined forces in January 2026. This merger means more opportunities, expanded resources, and a shared commitment to delivering exceptional member service. Together, we become more - empowering members, communities, and teams through a bold, unified future. Both organizations bring a strong legacy of member satisfaction, operational excellence, financial stability, and community impact. Recognized locally and nationally as best-in-class financial institutions and employers of choice, each is known for its commitment to financial well-being and philanthropic leadership. Join us during this transformative time and be part of shaping the future of banking! To learn more about the merger, click here.

Job Description

Position Summary

The Director of IT Audit plays a critical leadership role in shaping the future of technology risk assurance, insight regarding technology risks, and Internal Audit at Wings Credit Union. Reporting to the VP of Internal Audit, this leader is responsible for developing and executing the IT audit strategy while providing independent assurance, advisory services, and risk insights across the organization's technology, cybersecurity, data, and digital environments.

As a key member of the Internal Audit leadership team, the Director of IT Audit partners closely with executive leadership, technology leaders, risk partners, regulators, and the Audit Committee to evaluate and strengthen governance, risk management, and control practices. This leader is responsible for building and leading a high-performing IT Audit function, developing talent, enhancing audit methodologies, and providing assurance over the organization’s readiness for an evolving technology and risk landscape.

This role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise technology risk oversight, build and scale a modern IT audit function, develop future audit leaders, and help shape the future of Internal Audit within a growing and increasingly complex organization.

Essential Functions

IT Audit Strategy & Risk Oversight

Develop and maintain the IT audit universe, risk assessment methodology, and audit strategy to ensure appropriate coverage of technology, cybersecurity, data, operational resilience, and emerging risks.
Lead the development of risk-based audit, advisory, and continuous monitoring plans that align with organizational objectives, regulatory expectations, and evolving risk landscapes.
Evaluate emerging technology, cybersecurity, digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and operational risks to ensure audit coverage remains relevant and forward-looking.
Lead the integration of artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, digital transformation, and operational considerations into audit planning, risk assessments, and assurance strategies.
Establish both short- and long-term audit priorities, resource plans, and capability strategies that support the continued growth of the organization.
Ensure audit approaches remain appropriately aligned to the organization's risk profile, strategic priorities, and technology environment.

Audit Leadership & Execution Excellence

Provide leadership and oversight of the IT Audit portfolio, ensuring engagements are completed efficiently, effectively, and in accordance with Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
Approve audit scopes, objectives, and resource allocations while serving as an escalation point for complex issues, barriers, and emerging risks.
Monitor audit execution, resource utilization, project milestones, quality standards, and audit plan delivery while proactively identifying and addressing risks to successful delivery.
Ensure high standards of audit quality, consistency, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder engagement across all audit activities.
Drive continuous improvement efforts that enhance audit effectiveness, efficiency, and overall value delivered to the organization.

Leadership, Talent Development & Team Growth

Build, lead, coach, and develop a high-performing IT Audit team capable of supporting current and future organizational needs.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth.
Develop leadership capabilities across the team through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and meaningful development opportunities.
Assess future talent and capability needs while helping build a scalable audit function designed to support organizational growth.
Champion employee engagement initiatives that strengthen retention, team effectiveness, and performance.

Executive Partnership & Organizational Influence

Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership by providing meaningful insights into technology, cybersecurity, governance, and operational risks.
Translate complex audit results, risk trends, and control observations into practical recommendations that support informed decision-making and business performance.
Build strong relationships across technology, risk, compliance, and business functions while maintaining audit independence and objectivity.
Engage effectively with regulators, external auditors, and governance committees while representing the Internal Audit function with professionalism and credibility.
Partner with leaders across all lines of defense to support effective risk management and continuous improvement efforts.

Audit Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Lead the evolution of audit processes, methodologies, tools, and reporting practices to improve coverage, efficiency, and insight generation.
Lead the development and maturation of Internal Audit's artificial intelligence capabilities, including governance frameworks, audit methodology enhancements, documentation standards, risk assessment integration, assurance strategies, and AI-enabled auditing practices.
Promote the use of data analytics, automation, artificial intelligence, and technology-enabled auditing techniques across the audit lifecycle.
Identify opportunities to modernize the Internal Audit function and implement leading practices that support future-state audit capabilities.
Stay informed on industry developments, regulatory expectations, emerging technologies, and evolving audit practices to ensure continued relevance and effectiveness.

Bank Secrecy Act

Remain knowledgeable of and adhere to Wings policies, procedures, and regulations related to the Bank Secrecy Act.

Qualifications

Minimum Formal Qualifications for this Position:

Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology Operations, IT Security, Business Administration with a focus on Information Systems, or similar field of study required

This role combines hands-on delivery, executive communication, and practice leadership. The successful candidate will translate technical security risks into business impact, assess whether controls are appropriately designed and implemented, and partner with CISOs, CIOs, CFOs, General Counsel/Privacy Counsel, Risk Leaders, technology teams, and PE deal teams to drive pragmatic, measurable outcomes.

The ideal candidate brings deep GRC and privacy expertise together with sufficient technical depth to challenge control owners, evaluate cybersecurity architectures and operations, validate evidence, and connect technical findings to regulatory, risk, and business requirements.

Client Advisory & GRC Delivery

Lead end-to-end GRC and privacy engagements, including scoping, planning, execution, quality review, and executive reporting.

Design and operationalize cybersecurity governance models, including policies, standards, risk appetite, committees, reporting, KPIs, and KRIs.

Build and mature enterprise risk programs, including risk assessments, risk registers, control libraries, control rationalization, and control testing approaches.

Develop and implement security policies, standards, and procedures aligned to NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SOC 2, CMMC, and FedRAMP.

Support regulatory readiness and compliance initiatives, including SEC cyber disclosure support, NYDFS 500, GDPR/UK GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOX ITGC, CMMC, and FedRAMP alignment where applicable.

Stand up or enhance privacy programs, including data mapping and inventories, DPIAs/PIAs, DSAR processes, retention, consent management, third-party privacy risk, and privacy by design.

Perform vendor and third-party risk assessments and implement scalable TPRM operating models.

Technical Cybersecurity Assessment & Advisory

Assess technical security controls across cloud, network, endpoint, identity, application, data, and security operations environments, and connect control gaps to business and regulatory risk.

Evaluate security architecture and configuration evidence for common platforms and services, including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365, identity providers, firewalls, EDR/XDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, backup, and data protection technologies.

Review identity and access management capabilities, including privileged access, multifactor authentication, joiner-mover-leaver processes, access reviews, service accounts, and segregation of duties.

Assess vulnerability and patch management processes, interpret scan results, validate remediation prioritization, and evaluate exposure management practices.

Evaluate logging, monitoring, detection, and incident response capabilities, including alert coverage, escalation workflows, playbooks, tabletop exercises, and lessons learned.

Assess secure configuration, network segmentation, encryption, key management, backup and recovery, data loss prevention, and resilience controls.

Partner with technical teams to validate control implementation through interviews, documentation, configuration samples, screenshots, reports, tickets, and other evidence. The role is not expected to serve as a full-time engineer but must be able to credibly challenge technical assumptions and distinguish documented controls from operating controls.

Support cyber due diligence, post-acquisition integration, carve-outs, and rapid maturity uplift by identifying material technical risks and developing prioritized remediation roadmaps.

Executive Communication & Stakeholder Management

Translate complex technical, regulatory, and privacy requirements into clear, business-oriented recommendations.

Deliver executive-ready artifacts, including board and audit committee materials, risk heatmaps, maturity assessments, target operating models, roadmaps, and dashboards.

Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership; present findings confidently, facilitate difficult risk decisions, and influence action across business and technology stakeholders.

Support business development through proposal writing, SOW development, client presentations, solution shaping, and effort estimation.

Mentor and develop consultants and managers; lead teams across multiple engagements while maintaining quality, delivery rigor, and commercial discipline.

Partner with other CFGI service lines, including Accounting Advisory, CFO Advisory, and Technology Enablement, to deliver integrated solutions.

What You Must Have

8+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity GRC, technical risk, privacy, compliance, security consulting, or a combination of these areas.

Demonstrated experience implementing and operationalizing cybersecurity frameworks and control programs, including NIST CSF, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls, SOC 2, CMMC, or comparable frameworks, along with strong privacy fundamentals.

Working technical knowledge across at least four of the following domains: cloud security; IAM/PAM; network security; endpoint security; vulnerability management; SIEM/security monitoring; incident response; application security; data protection; or backup and recovery, with the ability to review technical artifacts and configuration evidence and identify control design or operating gaps.

What Sets You Apart

Experience performing or leading enterprise/security risk assessments, technical control assessments, control design and testing, policy and standards development, TPRM, and regulatory readiness programs.

Experience with GDPR/UK GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, with exposure to HIPAA, GLBA, or other sector-specific privacy requirements.

Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, CIPM/CIPP (E/US), CDPSE, or relevant cloud security certifications.

Hands-on experience with, or meaningful exposure to, Microsoft Azure, AWS, Microsoft 365 security, Entra ID, common SIEM and EDR platforms, vulnerability scanning tools, GRC platforms, and privacy management tools.

jobs.description:
Head of Technology & Systems

Bin There Dump That

Bin There Dump That is looking for a Head of Technology & Systems to lead the technology strategy, systems ecosystem, and technology transformation supporting our growing franchise network across Canada and the United States.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who understands that great technology is about more than systems. It is about making the business easier to operate, more reliable, more connected, and better equipped to scale.

The Head of Technology & Systems will work across our Home Office, Franchise Operations team, Franchise Operators, and technology partners to ensure our technology investments deliver meaningful business value.

What You'll Do

Develop and lead BTDT's technology strategy and roadmap.
Lead major system implementations, migrations, integrations, testing, and optimization.
Evaluate our technology ecosystem and identify opportunities to simplify, integrate, automate, and improve.
Manage key technology vendors and establish clear expectations for performance, reliability, service, and accountability.
Establish standards for system reliability, incident response, business continuity, backups, access, and technology governance.
Partner with Operations and Finance & Analytics to improve data quality, reporting, dashboards, and system integrations.
Evaluate opportunities to responsibly leverage AI, automation, CRM technology, and emerging tools.
Establish governance for third-party applications and integrations accessing BTDT systems, data, websites, or digital assets.
Support Franchise Operators with complex or systemic technology needs while developing scalable solutions for the broader network.
Ensure critical systems, integrations, processes, permissions, and technology dependencies are appropriately documented.
Translate complex technical issues into clear business recommendations for leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

What We Are Looking For

You are a technology leader who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. You understand systems and architecture but also understand people, processes, operations, and the importance of successful adoption.

Ideally, you bring:

Experience leading technology strategy, digital transformation, systems implementation, or technology consulting.
Strong experience with software migrations, integrations, APIs, SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data.
Experience managing technology vendors and complex cross-functional projects.
Knowledge of cybersecurity, access management, data governance, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
An understanding of AI, automation, and emerging business technologies.
Strong project and change-management capabilities.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to make complex technology understandable.
Experience in a franchise, multi-location, field-service, or distributed organization is an asset.

Why This Role?

This is an opportunity to help shape the next generation of technology at Bin There Dump That.You won't simply inherit an IT function. You'll have the opportunity to influence how our systems connect, how our data is used, how emerging technology is evaluated, and how technology supports Franchise Operators and Home Office teams across the organization.

Our goal is simple: use technology to make BTDT easier to operate, easier to scale, more reliable, and more data-driven.

If you are a business-minded technology leader who enjoys solving complex problems, building scalable systems, and turning technology into practical business results, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer / Co-Founder (Equity)
jobs.description:
Seeking an exceptional Chief Technology Officer / Co-Founder
to help build a vertically integrated artificial intelligence company spanning machine learning, high-performance computing, advanced systems engineering, and ultimately custom compute hardware.

Important: this is an early-stage co-founder position and is unpaid at the outset. Compensation will initially be equity-based, with cash compensation expected only as the company reaches appropriate financing or revenue milestones. Candidates should approach this as a genuine founding commitment, not a conventional salaried executive role.

This is not a conventional software-startup CTO role
. The position requires a deeply hands-on technical founder capable of working across the computing stack—from AI models and distributed systems through GPU infrastructure, compilers, accelerator architecture, semiconductor technology, and physical hardware.

The CTO will be expected to architect, prototype, code, benchmark, debug, research, experiment, and build.

Exceptional depth is sought across several of the following areas:
Machine learning, deep learning, foundation models, LLMs, training, fine-tuning, inference, quantization, and model evaluation
GPU computing, CUDA, Triton, TensorRT, vLLM, and comparable inference/runtime technologies
Distributed computing, HPC, multi-GPU systems, networking, memory optimization, and performance engineering
Python combined with strong systems-level development experience in Rust, C++, or comparable languages
Linux, containers, Kubernetes, MLOps, observability, and production infrastructure
AWS, Azure, GCP, bare-metal infrastructure, and hybrid or local compute architectures
RAG, embeddings, reranking, vector search, knowledge graphs, document intelligence, and agentic systems
Compiler technologies including LLVM, MLIR, XLA, Triton, or accelerator-oriented compiler stacks
Computer architecture, GPUs, NPUs, tensor accelerators, ASICs, FPGAs, RTL, memory hierarchies, and high-speed interconnects
Semiconductor fabrication, photolithography, EDA, physical design, process engineering, advanced packaging, chiplets, or tape-out
Advanced additive manufacturing, printed electronics, or emerging fabrication methods
Cybersecurity, edge computing, robotics, RF, defense technology, or other technically demanding systems environments

The technical bar is intentionally high, no candidate is expected to possess all listed skills.

The ideal candidate can understand an AI workload at the model level, profile its behavior at the systems level, identify bottlenecks imposed by current computing architectures, and reason downward toward a purpose-built accelerator.

Particular interest exists in people who have crossed traditional disciplinary boundaries: AI engineers who understand silicon, semiconductor engineers who understand machine-learning workloads, HPC engineers who have built sophisticated AI systems, compiler engineers who understand accelerator architecture, hardware engineers with serious software expertise, and researchers capable of turning theory into working systems.

This is fundamentally a builder role
. The CTO must be comfortable operating without a large engineering organization, an established playbook, or layers of abstraction separating leadership from implementation.

Exceptional critical thinking ability, technical independence, curiosity, and the ability to rapidly become competent in unfamiliar disciplines matter as much as any particular technology stack.

Since 1847, The City College of New York has provided a high quality and affordable education to generations of New Yorkers in a wide variety of disciplines. CCNY embraces its role at the forefront of social change.


Located in the heart of New York City, CCNY is home to such important 'firsts' as: The first college explicitly founded on the ideal of educating the 'whole people', the first documentary film program in the U.S., the first intercollegiate lacrosse game played in the U.S., first student government in the nation, and the longest running Alumni Association in the U.S. It is ranked \#1 by The Chronicle of Higher Education out of 369 selective public colleges in the United States on the overall mobility index. This measure reflects both access and outcomes, representing the likelihood that a student at CCNY can move up two or more income quintiles. In addition, the Center for World University Rankings places CCNY in the top 1\.2% of universities worldwide in terms of academic excellence. More than 17,000 students pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees in seven professional schools and divisions, driven by significant funded research, creativity and scholarship. CCNY is as diverse, dynamic and visionary as New York City itself.


Outstanding programs in architecture, engineering, education, liberal arts and sciences prepare our students for the future, and produce outstanding leaders in every field. Whether they are drawn to the traditional, like philosophy or sociology, or emerging fields like sonic arts or biomedical engineering. CCNY boasts over 50 master's programs and have leading doctoral programs in engineering, the laboratory sciences, and psychology.


Our undergraduates have unique opportunities to conduct research with professors and, publish and present their findings. In our science, engineering and social science programs, more than 300 undergrads work alongside senior researchers in funded projects. leading CUNY in funded research, we house a number of research centers, with our two $700M advanced research centers leading the way. Nearly all of our full\-time faculty hold PhDs or like our architecture faculty, maintain professional practices. Art professors exhibit their work, film professors make films, and music professors perform in venues around the country.


The campus is alive with student activity. City College fields 16 varsity teams that compete in NCAA Division Ill \-and students work out in an equipment rich fitness center and socialize in more than 100 student clubs. Our students come from all over the world, representing more than 150 nationalities. City College is an integral part of the civic, urban and artistic energy of New York and inseparable from its history. We are the city that built this city.

The City College of New York (CCNY) seeks a dynamic, strategic, and collaborative leader to serve as the Vice President for Information technology. As a key member of the college's executive operational leadership team, the VP reports directly to the Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer. This role will oversee the full lifecycle of the information technology strategy, service delivery, and operational excellence across the campus and in close partnership with the CUNY Central IT office. Areas of responsibility include, front line service delivery for students, faculty, and staff, application development, enterprise infrastructure services, including information security, classroom technology, project management office, IT business management, and IT strategy development.


The VP of Information Technology is a strategic, hands\-on people leader responsible for building and scaling the technology infrastructure of a growing campus. Operating as a senior stakeholder in the organization, this role requires equal parts, strategic vision and operational execution in a fast\-moving, relationship\-driven environment. The ideal candidate will be a transformative leader capable of modernizing traditional IT environments.

Overview:

The Director, IT is responsible for leading the organization’s IT operations, technology services, and overall IT strategy. This role provides leadership and direction across IT support, infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity, identity and access management, and technology operations to ensure reliable, secure, and effective technology services across the organization.  

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, the Director, IT establishes priorities, develops and maintains IT standards and processes, manages technology risks, and ensures IT services align with business needs and organizational objectives. This position serves as a senior technology leader and trusted partner to stakeholders across the organization.
This role requires a strong balance of strategic leadership, operational oversight, technical knowledge, and people leadership. The Director, IT is responsible for building a responsive and accountable IT function, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring a consistently positive experience for employees and business partners.

* Assess technology needs and make recommendations regarding systems, infrastructure, applications, and services.

jobs.description:
**Why Join Team SB**
--------------------

  

  

  

**Shape San Bernardino’s Future!**  

**Are you a dynamic leader and excellent communicator with a background in Information Technology or a related field who is ready to make a meaningful impact?** **The City of San Bernardino is seeking a Director of Information Technology (U) interested in** **planning, organizing, directing and managing the activities and operations of the Information Technology Department by providing expert professional assistance and guidance to the City Manager and departments on technology strategy, long\-term technology initiatives and investments and uses of technology to solve operational needs and problems.**  

As a future member of our team, you’ll be joining a city with deep roots, cultural diversity, and exciting momentum. Located in the heart of Southern California’s Inland Empire, San Bernardino is the county seat and largest city in San Bernardino County, home to more than 222,000 residents. Its rich history — shaped by Native American, Mexican, and Spanish influences — continues to inspire the city’s evolving identity.


San Bernardino offers access to major transit corridors, natural beauty, and a wide range of housing and lifestyle options. It’s a place where public service careers are supported by a strong sense of community and purpose — and where motivated professionals can grow, contribute, and be part of something meaningful.

  

  

The Information Technology Department provides Citywide technology leadership, services, and support to ensure secure, reliable, and efficient operations across all City departments. The Department provides expert professional assistance and guidance to the City Manager and departments on technology strategy, long\-term initiatives and investments, and the use of technology to address operational needs and challenges. Key areas of responsibility include business and public safety applications, network and telecommunications infrastructure, cybersecurity and data management, Geographic Information Systems (GIS), and centralized technical support.  

  

  

  

The Director of Information Technology (U) is a key member of the City’s Executive Leadership Team, providing strategic leadership and direction for the City’s technology operations and initiatives. The Director oversees the Information Technology Department and ensures the delivery of secure, reliable, and effective technology services that support Citywide operations. Key areas of responsibility include:
**Administration \& Strategy:** Oversees departmental operations, personnel, budgets, technology investments, policies, and long\-range strategic planning. Advises City leadership on technology initiatives, emerging trends, and policy matters.


**Information Systems \& GIS:** Directs the development, implementation, and support of Citywide business applications, public safety systems, enterprise databases, and specialized GIS services.


**Infrastructure \& Telecommunications:** Oversees City networks, computer systems, hardware, software, data communications, and telecommunications services while establishing technology standards and evaluating major system investments.


**Cybersecurity \& Business Continuity:** Directs information security, data management, system reliability, backup, disaster recovery, and related policies and standards to protect City systems and information.


**Customer \& Technology Support:** Oversees centralized help desk, system maintenance, technical support, and user training services to ensure responsive and effective technology support across City departments.

  

  

***STARTING SALARY WILL BE EVALUATED BASED ON EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE, AND INTERNAL EQUITY.***  

  

**What You'll Be Doing Here**
-----------------------------


**The Ideal Candidate:**
  

The ideal candidate for Director of Information Technology (U) is a strategic and collaborative leader with a strong administrative background and extensive knowledge of information technology systems. They will bring a clear vision for the department, and a demonstrated ability to successfully deliver complex technology projects on schedule.


Key qualities include:


* Strong leadership and team\-building skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while exercising sound independent judgment
* Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities
* Ability to break down organizational silos and foster teamwork, creativity, and accountability
* Strong analytical, strategic planning, and problem\-solving capabilities
* Ability to partner effectively with department heads to support Citywide service delivery
* Skilled in building partnerships with internal teams, elected officials, and community stakeholders

  

  

For more information on this position please **click here** to view the job description.
**What You Need to Qualify**
----------------------------


**Education and Experience:**


Bachelor’s degree in management information systems, computer science, business administration, or a closely related field; and at least ten (10\) years of progressively responsible information technology experience, at least four (4\) of which were in a management capacity; or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience. Experience in a governmental setting is preferred.


**Licenses, Certifications, and Equipment:**


A valid California driver’s license is required.


**Physical Requirements and Work Environment:**


Employees work under typical office conditions, and the noise level is usually quiet. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, or hear, both in person and by telephone, use hands to manipulate, handle, and feel computers and standard business equipment, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand and walk. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Microsoft Global Enterprise Sales (GES) aims to deliver the full value of Microsoft to customers and lead their Frontier Transformation. We are looking for a passionate, experienced security leader for the role of **Field Chief Information Security Officer\-Manufacturing \& Mobility (MFM)** for our customers across the Enterprise and Industry segments


As a trusted advisor to customer Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), Chief Executive Officer (CxOs) and board, you will be the face of our company’s security initiatives and solutions, responsible for cultivating relationships with decision makers. Your primary role involves understanding their short\- and long\-term security needs and providing expert guidance to enhance their security posture. You will be integral to landing Microsoft as a leader in cybersecurity, ensuring our solutions meet their business objectives. The Customer Security Officer (CSO) will be part of the Corporate Vice Presidents (CVPs) extended leadership team and provide advice on the security business while also ensuring leader enablement. They will play an active role in building out the account strategy, building trust with CISOs, and other CxOs with a security interest, to drive successful strategic pursuits. They will actively engage in industry forums, providing insights on security, privacy and regulatory requirements and positioning Microsoft as the Security leader.

* Engage with customer C\-suite executive with Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) being the primary role, to understand their strategic objectives.
* Develop and nurture trusted advisor relationships helping CISO mature their security program by establishing the foundation for quality of platform security program architecture leveraging industry frameworks and standards.
* Develop strategic, operational, and tactical recommendations tailored to each customer with the intent of improving customer security posture and compliance position, aligned with their business goals and risk tolerance.

jobs.description:
LOCATION: US – Austin  
TYPE: Full time  
WORK SHIFT: Hybrid  
POSTED: September 28, 2026  
ID: JR0132259  
Overview  
At Western Union, we’re more than a trusted name in global payments. We’re moving beyond remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers.  


Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital\-first company, built on the strength of our retail foundation and powered by next\-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people prosper.  


Our customers inspire us to push boundaries and create services that make life easier and communities stronger. Wherever you are in the world, we’re committed to shaping the next generation of financial experiences.  


Join us as we go beyond and be part of a team that’s redefining what’s possible.  
We are seeking a seasoned Vice President of Cyber Governance, Risk \& Compliance to lead the strategy, execution, and continuous maturation of our cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance program. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, this leader will oversee the frameworks, processes, and teams responsible for cyber risk governance, regulatory readiness, policy management, control assurance, third\-party cyber risk oversight, and related GRC capabilities.  


In addition to leading Cyber GRC, this executive will serve as Deputy CISO for Western Union, supporting the CISO in the leadership and execution of the broader enterprise cybersecurity strategy. The Deputy CISO will represent the CISO in designated executive, Board, regulatory, business, and technology forums; help coordinate priorities across cybersecurity functions; provide leadership during significant cyber incidents; and assume delegated CISO responsibilities as required.  


The successful candidate will combine deep GRC and financial services expertise with the executive presence, business acumen, cybersecurity knowledge, and leadership capabilities necessary to operate across the full breadth of the cybersecurity organization.  


Role Responsibilities (GRC):  


Lead the cyber GRC function and define strategic roadmap, operating model, and maturity targets.  
Maintain governance structures supporting cyber risk decision\-making, escalation, and executive oversight.  
Drive cyber risk appetite, exception management, and risk acceptance processes.  
Oversee cyber and technology risk assessment methodologies and execution.  
Develop and maintain executive and Board\-level cyber risk reporting and metrics.  
Lead preparation and coordination for regulatory exams, internal/external audits, and customer assessments related to cybersecurity.  
Oversee control framework management, evidence programs, and issue remediation governance.  
Own lifecycle management of security policies, standards, and governance documentation.  
Oversee cyber due diligence and ongoing risk monitoring for third\-party vendors, partners, and strategic providers.  
Build, mentor, and scale a high\-performing GRC team.  


Role Responsibilities (Deputy CISO):  


Support the CISO in defining and executing the enterprise cybersecurity strategy.  
Serve as a strategic advisor to the CISO on cybersecurity risk, organizational priorities, investment decisions, regulatory matters, and emerging threats.  
Represent the CISO in designated executive, Board, business, technology, regulatory, risk, and governance forums.  
Help coordinate strategy, priorities, dependencies, and execution across cybersecurity functions.  
Promote integration among Security Operations, GRC, IAM, Security Engineering, Architecture, Application Security, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Fraud, and other relevant capabilities.  
Participate in cybersecurity strategic planning, budgeting, workforce planning, investment prioritization, and organizational design.  
Assist in preparing and delivering Board and executive\-level cybersecurity reporting.  
Represent cybersecurity during significant regulatory examinations and interactions when delegated by the CISO.  
Identify cross\-functional gaps and organizational risks and drive accountability for their resolution.  
Provide leadership continuity for the cybersecurity organization during periods when the CISO is unavailable.  
Assume additional CISO responsibilities and authorities when specifically delegated.  
Foster a culture of transparency, accountability, constructive challenge, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  
Build trusted relationships across Technology, Operations, Product, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Internal Audit, and business leadership  


Role Requirements:  


Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.  
15\+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, audit, compliance, or governance roles.  
7\+ years of people leadership experience with increasing organizational scope.  
Proven experience building, transforming, or materially uplifting cyber GRC programs in financial services or similarly regulated industries.  
Deep knowledge of cybersecurity governance, financial services regulatory expectations, security/control frameworks, audit/regulatory exams, and third\-party cyber risk programs.  
Experience interacting directly with senior executives, Boards, regulators, auditors, and risk committees.  
Demonstrated understanding of cybersecurity beyond GRC, including security operations, identity, application security, cloud security, incident response, security engineering, architecture, and emerging technology risk.  
Demonstrated ability to translate cybersecurity and technology risks into business terms and actionable executive decisions.  
Possesses at least one of the following professional credentials (or other industry\-related credential): CISSP, CRISC, CISM, CISA  


The successful candidate will demonstrate:  


Executive presence and sound judgment  
Strategic and enterprise\-level thinking  
Strong knowledge of cybersecurity and technology risk  
Regulatory fluency

Company Details: **Berkley Accident and Health** is a risk management company that designs innovative solutions to address the unique challenges of each client. With our entrepreneurial culture and a strong emphasis on analytics, we can help employers better manage their risk. We offer a broad range of products, including employer stop loss, benefit captives, provider stop loss, HMO reinsurance, and specialty accident. The key to Berkley’s success is our nimble approach to risk – our ability to quickly understand, think through, and devise a plan that addresses each client’s challenges, coupled with the strong backing of a Fortune 500 company. Our parent company, **W. R. Berkley Corporation**, is one of the largest and best managed property/casualty insurers in the United States.
\#LI\-AV1 \#LI\-HYBRID
The Company is an equal employment opportunity employer.
Responsibilities:

The **Vice President, Technology \& Data Solutions** will serve as a key partner to business leaders across the organization, ensuring that Berkley Accident \& Health's technology platforms, data capabilities, and reporting solutions effectively support our strategic objectives. This role combines technology leadership, vendor management, data strategy, business partnership, and operational oversight. The successful candidate will help align technology investments with business priorities while ensuring employees have the tools and information they need to be successful. ***This role will be based in our West Hartford, CT office. We offer a hybrid work schedule with 4 days in the office; and 1 day remote where it makes sense to do so.***  

**What you can expect:*** Culture of innovation, teamwork, supportive colleagues and leaders willing to invest in talent
* Internal mobility opportunities
* Visibility to senior leaders and partnership with cross functional teams
* Opportunity to impact change
* Benefits – competitive compensation, paid time off, comprehensive wellness benefits and programs, employer funded health savings account, profit sharing, 401k, paid parental leave, employee stock purchase plan, tuition assistance and professional continuing education

**We'll count on you to:*** Own and manage relationships with the company's key technology vendors and strategic technology partners, while driving vendor accountability, performance, and continuous improvement
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and vendors to evaluate enhancements, integrations, and emerging technology solutions
* Partner with business operations to identify and execute a portfolio of AI and automation related initiatives
* Oversee database management, data quality, and information architecture
* Own and enhance reporting capabilities that support underwriting, sales, claims, finance, and executive leadership
* Facilitate prioritization of technology initiatives, balancing business impact, resource availability, and organizational goals
* Interface with Berkley Technology Support (BTS) on corporate related technology initiatives.
* Ensure employees have reliable technology tools, equipment, and support to perform their roles effectively.
* Support technology onboarding and operational processes for approximately 225 employees.
* Maintain a high level of service and responsiveness for internal technology support functions.

  


Qualifications:
**What you need to have:*** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* 15 \+ years of experience in management, implementation and execution of various IT projects.
* Strong IT and data infrastructure capabilities.
* Familiarity with David Young System/Connexure, Salesforce or other database management systems
* Able to work with the IT management staff, suppliers, developers and daily IT operations.

**What makes you stand out:*** Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills.
* Experience within the insurance, or other related industries.
* Familiarity with managing large technology vendor relationships.
* Experience leading technology modernization and business process improvement initiatives.

  


Additional Company Details: We do not accept any unsolicited resumes from external recruiting agencies or firms. The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include: • Base Salary Range: $200,000 \- $225,000 • Eligible to participate in annual discretionary bonus. • Eligible for long term incentive compensation • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit\-Sharing plans. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Sponsorship Details: Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

jobs.title: Head of Digital Transformation and CIO | Onsite @ Centenary University
jobs.description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:
**Location:** Onsite at **Centenary University**

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, salaried position with **Ellucian**

**Compensation: Base salary \+15% annual bonus**

**Relocation:** Open to candidates who require relocation; **relocation assistance is available**


Ellucian is seeking to hire a **Head of Digital Transformation and CIO** that will work onsite at **Centenary University.** As the Head of Digital Transformation/CIO, you will be a trusted advisor to the President on the advancement of innovative technology strategy, adoption and impact to the college. You will lead both strategic and tactical activities and campus communications to build consensus around the value of collaboration in a private higher education institution and engaging with other CIOs, while ensuring the alignment of Ellucian strategy, processes, and resources to drive the institution’s strategic plan. The incumbent must have the ability to challenge conventional thinking with new ideas, approaches, and solutions through personal influence to promote transformation. The position requires professionalism, confidentiality, organization, prioritization, excellent interpersonal skills, strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to garner respect and confidence of colleagues through listening, learning, and forging working relationships and synergies across the college.**Where you will make an impact*** Maintain an exceptionally high level of professionalism, responsiveness, and ongoing proactive collaboration with President and other Executive Leadership Team Members.
* Develop and sustain positive relationships with the institution’s community, faculty, staff and students.
* Establish and direct the strategic and tactical goals, policies, and procedures in the best interest of the institution.
* Communicate strategic priorities and implementation plans to internal and external stakeholders.
* Drive technology transformation and change within the institution, ensuring the campus is informed, consulted and enabled along the way.
* Implement a modern technology governance process.
* Communicate governance process, plans, and status updates.
* Assess, anticipate, and manage technology projects and recommend appropriate action and resources.
* Help translate goals into executable tactics through identifying responsible parties, needed resources, deadlines, and assessments.
* Participation and collaboration across the university community to bring effective technology leadership aligned with the Centenary University President’s Office.
* Stay abreast of emerging higher education issues, trends in technology and development, and state and federal requirements, regulatory reporting, etc.
* Perform other duties as delegated by the President.
* Serve as an industry and customer expert back into the broader Ellucian departments/divisions.

**What will you bring*** 10\+ years of experience in the Information Technology field or equivalent combination of education and experience leading IT strategic initiatives in a college or university environment.
* Prior experience serving on campus executive leadership teams including the President.
* The successful candidate must have broad direct and relevant knowledge of higher education with the ability to be sensitive and tactful, with high emotional intelligence.
* Current knowledge in use and trends of technology in higher education.
* Good understanding of Ellucian administrative/academic computing solutions, Ellucian Student (Colleague Preferred), and other third\-party systems/solutions connected to the ERP/SIS.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong advising, empathizing and influencing abilities.
* Ability to travel up to 25%.


What makes \#Ellucianlife:
* Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision
* Flexible time off
* Thrive Flex Lifestyle Account (LSA) that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
* 401k w/ match \& BrightPlan \- to help you save for the future

jobs.title: Director, Technical Program Manager (EPTech)
jobs.description:
Director, Technical Program Manager (EPTech)
Do you love driving complex technical initiatives and pioneering in the technology space? Do you enjoy solving complex business problems in a fast\-paced, collaborative, inclusive, and iterative delivery environment? At Capital One, you'll be part of a big group of makers, breakers, doers and disruptors, who love to solve real problems and meet real customer needs. We are seeking Technical Program Managers who are passionate about marrying technology with business strategy to join our team. As a Technical Program Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to be on the forefront of driving major technical transformations and scaling platform capabilities across Capital One.

  

Enterprise Platforms Technology (**EPTech**) comprises many of Capital One’s most important enterprise platforms. We establish practices for building technology solutions across the company and deliver capabilities that exemplify those practices.

  

As a Director TPM in EPTech, you will leverage your technical acumen and engineering experience to drive the strategy and execution of large\-scale, technically complex, cross\-functional programs aligned with Capital One’s business priorities. You’ll break down complexity and organizational silos, influence roadmaps, dive deep into system design and architecture, make technical tradeoffs, drive platform consolidation, and identify, resolve, define, and escalate mitigation plans for hard technical dependencies.

 **What You’ll Do:**


As a Director of Technical Program Management (TPM), we’re looking for someone that can help us lead programs that deliver on critical business goals and build large scale products \& platforms that will help Capital One customers have incredible experiences.

  

In addition to the technical program, you will also work to pave the way for an expanding TPM discipline within the team, by leveraging your industry knowledge and experience to teach the organization what a great TPM can achieve.

  

* Contribute to the organization’s TPM / Delivery strategy: establish operating mechanisms, maturity models, and tooling that scale across portfolios
* Drive development of and alignment on program roadmap anchored in business objectives, definition of done, technical solutions, and sequencing of dependencies
* Lead cross\-platform technical investment planning and ensure architectural alignment toward long\-term platform convergence and reuse
* Serve as an executive\-level escalation point for program risks, influencing technology leaders to make data\-driven tradeoffs between speed, cost and resiliency
* Ensure definition of measurable outcomes of platform success (availability, scalability, cost efficiency, developer velocity) and ensure delivery accountability across multiple engineering teams

 **Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field
* At least 7 years of experience managing technical programs

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* 7\+ years of experience designing and building solutions using distributed computing or service oriented architecture (SOA)
* 3\+ years of experience in building distributed systems \& highly available services using cloud computing services / architecture \- preferably using AWS
* 3\+ years experience building highly scalable products \& platforms
* 3\+ years of experience with Agile delivery
* 3\+ years years experience delivering large and complex programs \- where you contribute to the business or technical vision, collaborate with large cross\-functional teams, secure commitments on deliverables and unblock teams to land business impact
* Experience in building systems \& solutions within a highly regulated environment
* MBA or Master’s Degree in a related technical field (Computer Science, Software Engineering)
* PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
* 3\+ years of people management experience or influencing organization as an IC
* Experience driving platform standardization across multiple product portfolios or lines of business
* Track record of building TPM maturity (operating models, career frameworks, metrics) at scale within engineering organizations
* Exceptional communication and influence skills, capable of engaging deeply with technical teams while translating implications into compelling business narratives that persuade senior leadership

 ***At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization, or offer any immigration related support for this position (e.g. H1B, F\-1 OPT, F\-1 STEM OPT, F\-1 CPT, J\-1, TN, E\-3, and O\-1, or any other forms of work authorization that require immigration support from an employer).***

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Technology Strategy & Value Management
jobs.description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

  

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

 **Work Schedule**


This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in your time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

  

Applicants who live within 35 miles of either the Burlington, NC or Durham, NC location will follow a hybrid schedule. This schedule includes a minimum of three in\-office days per week at an assigned location, either Burlington or Durham, supporting both collaboration and flexibility.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**

**ENTERPRISE TECHNOLOGY STRATEGY \& STRATEGIC PLANNING**

* Lead the enterprise technology strategy and strategic planning process, translating the CITO’s vision and enterprise business priorities into a cohesive, multi\-year technology strategy, strategic roadmap, and investment agenda.
* Establish the annual strategic framework and priorities for Technology, aligning strategic objectives, investment allocation, organizational capacity, and measurable business outcomes.
* Lead strategy development and alignment across Technology leadership, ensuring business strategy, technology priorities, architecture direction, product and platform roadmaps, and investment decisions operate as an integrated system.
* Connect strategy to execution by establishing clear accountability between strategic objectives, funded investments and value streams, executive ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Advise senior Technology and business leadership on strategic priorities, investment alternatives, enterprise trade\-offs, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to accelerate business and technology transformation.

**ENTERPRISE PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT \& GOVERNANCE**

* Establish and lead the Enterprise Portfolio Office (EPO), providing enterprise\-wide governance and transparency across technology investments, products, platforms, strategic initiatives, capacity, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
* Own the enterprise portfolio planning lifecycle, including demand management, prioritization, investment planning, capacity allocation, portfolio optimization, and periodic re\-planning.
* Define and evolve portfolio governance for a product\- and platform\-based operating model, establishing outcome\-based decision frameworks and investment guardrails that enable speed while maintaining appropriate enterprise oversight.
* Lead executive portfolio and value reviews, providing senior leadership with actionable insight into portfolio performance, investment alignment, capacity, risks, dependencies, and opportunities to reallocate resources based on changing priorities and realized value.
* Orchestrate portfolio decision\-making for senior Technology and enterprise governance forums, ensuring major investment decisions and trade\-offs are supported by clear business, financial, technology, and value considerations.

**VALUE MANAGEMENT \& BENEFITS REALIZATION**

* Establish and lead the Value Management Office (VMO) framework, methodology, and governance, shifting organizational focus from activity and delivery outputs toward measurable business outcomes and realized value.
* Define the enterprise benefits\-realization framework, establishing expected value for significant technology investments and measuring outcomes throughout and beyond the investment lifecycle.
* Lead value engineering across the technology portfolio, challenging investment assumptions, scope, sequencing, and solution alternatives to improve return on investment, accelerate time\-to\-value, and maximize enterprise outcomes.
* Partner with business, product, platform, and value\-stream leaders to embed value management into strategic roadmaps, investment decisions, portfolio reviews, and ongoing funding decisions.
* Own the enterprise technology business\-case framework, establishing consistent standards for evaluating, comparing, approving, and measuring significant technology investments.

**TECHNOLOGY BUSINESS MANAGEMENT \& INVESTMENT ANALYTICS**

**Position Description:**

The University of Louisville is hiring a Research Projects Program Manager. The position, with a specialty in operational technology testing and validation, will serve as the overall event director, working to plan, coordinate, and execute testing and validation experiences in support of the Department of War (DoW). This role is responsible for developing event scenarios, assigning team roles, monitoring progress, and ensuring successful delivery of all program objectives.  



  

This is a grant funded position with funding through August 15, 2027\. Continued employment is contingent upon the availability of funds.  



  

This position supports defense‑related projects funded by a U.S. Department of Defense grant. An offer of employment is contingent upon the selected candidate being eligible for and able to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance (Secret or higher) and any necessary export control licenses to perform the job functions.  



  

This is an in\-person position.  

  



Key Responsibilities


* Serve as the primary point of contact for DoD sponsors and stakeholders.
* Design, plan, and execute technology testing events, field exercises, and validation experiences that simulate real\-world operational conditions relevant to current defense priorities and contemporary conflict environments.
* Coordinate with military stakeholders, technical subject matter experts, academic partners, and industry participants to develop realistic test scenarios, success criteria, and evaluation frameworks.
* Oversee project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to ensure all milestones and deliverables are met.
* Assign roles and responsibilities to project staff and ensure clear communication across all functional areas.
* Manage logistics and operational execution for field demonstrations, prototype testing, and technology assessment events, including site coordination, scheduling, resource allocation, equipment support, and vendor readiness.
* Excellent communication skills are required, as this position will interact with a variety of personnel across academic, industry, defense, and federal funding landscapes.
* Track participant progress, testing outcomes, technology performance metrics, and program impact; collect and analyze data to generate reports and demonstrate measurable outcomes aligned with relevant Statement of Work requirements.
Develop after\-action reports, lessons learned, and recommendations for technology refinement, follow\-on funding opportunities, and transition pathways into defense acquisition or pilot programs.  
* 

  

Preferred Qualifications


* 5 \+ years of direct experience in program management, defense technology testing, operational exercises, field demonstrations, or technology validation environments.
* Experience coordinating complex technical projects involving multiple stakeholders, vendors, and operational constraints.
* Ability to effectively communicate technical and operational concepts with a variety of audiences.
* Proven expertise in managing programs, including planning, execution, budgeting, risk management, logistics coordination, and delivery of technical demonstrations or validation events (PMP certification or equivalent experience a plus).
* Familiarity with defense innovation, prototype evaluation, dual\-use technologies, autonomy systems, sensing platforms, communications technologies, or advanced manufacturing solutions preferred.
Military service and experience with planning and executing military exercises are highly desired.  
* 

**Compensation will be commensurate to candidate experience.**

jobs.description:
Copilot said:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Austin, TX (Hybrid)
💰 Compensation:
$200,000–$230,000 Base Salary + Up to 25% Annual Bonus
About the Opportunity
A rapidly growing, multi-location organization with operations across numerous markets nationwide is seeking an experienced Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
to lead enterprise technology strategy and execution. Technology is a key driver of the company's continued growth, supporting lead generation, customer engagement, sales operations, field services, analytics, and executive decision-making.
This executive leadership position offers the opportunity to influence company-wide strategy while building and scaling a high-performing technology organization.
Position Overview
The CTO serves as the senior technology executive responsible for defining and executing the organization's technology vision, ensuring technology investments align with business objectives and support future growth.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of strategic leadership, operational excellence, and a proven ability to drive innovation, security, scalability, and digital transformation in a high-growth environment.
Key Responsibilities
Technology Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute enterprise-wide technology strategy aligned with business goals.
Advise executive leadership on cybersecurity, AI, cloud platforms, infrastructure, enterprise applications, and emerging technologies.
Create technology roadmaps that support growth, efficiency, scalability, and security.
Evaluate technology investments based on business value, risk, and long-term sustainability.
Establish governance frameworks, standards, and best practices.

Technology Operations
Oversee infrastructure, cloud environments, cybersecurity, networking, enterprise systems, and end-user technologies.
Ensure technology services remain secure, reliable, scalable, and operationally efficient.
Drive continuous improvement through performance metrics and operational excellence initiatives.

Enterprise Applications & Digital Transformation
Lead strategy for CRM, ERP, contact center technologies, collaboration platforms, and core business applications.
Reduce technical debt while enhancing platform performance, reliability, and user experience.
Partner with business leaders to optimize workflows and operational effectiveness.

Data, AI & Innovation
Develop strategies for data governance, analytics, AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
Build decision-support capabilities that improve business outcomes.
Identify innovative solutions that create measurable business value.

Cybersecurity & Business Continuity
Lead cybersecurity strategy, risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Strengthen organizational resilience and security awareness.
Protect critical systems, customer information, and business operations.

Financial & Vendor Management
Manage technology budgets, investment planning, and resource allocation.
Oversee strategic vendor partnerships and service delivery performance.
Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions to maximize ROI.

Team Leadership & Development
Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional technology talent.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Develop future leaders through coaching, mentorship, and career development.

Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master's preferred).
Extensive experience leading enterprise technology organizations through growth and transformation.
Proven success developing technology strategy and managing large-scale technology operations.
Experience overseeing cybersecurity, cloud platforms, infrastructure, enterprise applications, data initiatives, and customer-facing technologies.
Strong financial, operational, and organizational leadership capabilities.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred
Experience supporting geographically distributed service, retail, construction, consumer services, or field-based organizations.
Experience supporting high-volume sales and contact center environments.

jobs.description:
What IT Program & Project Management Office (PMO) contributes to Cardinal Health

The PMO drives business outcomes by transforming strategic vision into execution through robust program governance, modern tools, and proactive change leadership. This function mobilizes high-performing project teams, aligns resource capacity to strategic priorities, and establishes clear accountability for deliverables. As financial and operational stewards, this job family optimizes project investments, proactively mitigates risks, and ensures rigorous adherence to quality standards while leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to ensure project success is achieved and outcomes are realized.

The Director, Technology Strategy & Execution (IT PMO) is a key leader in the IT Project Management Office responsible for shaping the portfolio and maximizing its strategic value. This role goes beyond traditional execution metrics; while maintaining a rigorous focus on delivering projects on time, within scope, and on budget, this leader ensures that the fundamental business case is met, strategic outcomes are achieved, and long-term business value is realized. This leader will oversee a portfolio of complex IT initiatives, ensuring close alignment with organizational goals, and will be instrumental in evolving the PMO into a high-performing strategic partner that actively shapes and protects business investments.

Location
- Nationwide, fully remote (with preference towards candidates in ET/CT, willing and able to travel to our global HQ in Central Ohio 5-10%)

Responsibilities

Portfolio & Strategic Alignment: Champion the IT PMO strategy by shifting from administrative progress reporting to actively shaping the enterprise portfolio, ensuring investments directly drive strategic business value and outcomes.
Predictive PMO Enablement: Champion the adoption of Planview and the integration of AI-driven insights, focusing on what will happen to drive proactive decision-making rather than merely reporting on what has already occurred.
Talent Leadership & Workforce Coaching: Build a future-ready workforce by upskilling, mentoring, and coaching project managers; cultivate critical situational skills including critical thinking, relationship building, and thriving in ambiguity.
Upstream Demand Shaping (“Shift Left”): Drive proactive “shift left” processes, including pre-project estimating and business-case planning, to ensure new work is rigorously scoped and aligned to strategic goals before execution begins.
Empowered Truth & Accountability: Foster a high-trust culture where PMO professionals are empowered to drive accountability, speak the truth on project health, and proactively escalate risks and critical dependencies.
Executive Risk & Resource Stewardship: Partner with senior leadership to assess enterprise-wide project risks, strategic dependencies, and resource constraints, facilitating timely, data-driven decisions and governance.
Vendor Accountability & Value Management: Collaborate with Solution Owners and Indirect Procurement to actively manage technology investments, leveraging strategic partnerships and holding vendors accountable to maximize delivered value.
Strategic Influence & Negotiation: Drive consensus and alignment across diverse, cross-functional stakeholder groups in sensitive or complex business situations while maintaining positive, collaborative relationships.

Strong leadership capabilities with experience in championing talent development, coaching, and building a high-performing, resilient team.
