jobs.title: Growth Platforms - Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice - Global Sale & Solution Center - Architect, Senior Manager - C_MAT
jobs.description:
The Team

Deloitte delivers Microsoft services globally across strategy, architecture, implementation, and operations. Our global network offers a flexible delivery model enabling us to best serve our clients, markets, geographies with integrated solutions and services. We are recognized as a global leader in Cloud and Digital transformation. IMPORTANT NOTE: Microsoft is a Deloitte audit client, so we cannot and do not have an alliance or partnership with Microsoft.

Deloitte is recognized as an undisputed global leader in a high-growth and rapidly transforming market. We architect strategies for growth transformation and value creation. We use digital innovation to unlock business value through the power of technology. Given Deloitte's attest relationship with Microsoft it is also a priority objective to understand and promote our need for independence globally.

The Role

The Deloitte Microsoft Technology Practice is seeking a Microsoft Global Sales and Solution Center (GSSC) Architect to support strategic client opportunities. This full-time role works within a rotational, cross-functional team of architects and enablement professionals from Global Member Firms and the USI shared services team. The architect should bring deep expertise in Microsoft Azure and working knowledge across Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Microsoft Security, and Microsoft Copilot and agentic AI capabilities. The role requires experience in enterprise architecture, solution shaping, estimation, commercial modeling, and delivery leadership. Experience working with Deloitte practices is preferred. The GSSC coordinates across business, industry, and technology teams to accelerate offering development and provide a central hub for pursuit architecture, estimation, responsible AI, security, and delivery planning for strategic Microsoft pursuits in the U.S., including Government & Public Services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/16/2026.

Work You'll Do

Strategic Responsibilities

Contribute to the vision, operating model, and roadmap for Microsoft GSSC initiatives in partnership with practice leadership and the Microsoft CTO/Chief Architect community.
Lead architecture and commercial shaping for complex Microsoft pursuits spanning Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Security, and Copilot and agentic AI solutions.
Translate business and industry outcomes into secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-optimized reference architectures w/ Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Shape responsible AI and agentic solutions, including model and agent selection, grounding and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, observability, human oversight, and content-safety controls.
Establish trusted client relationships and guide pursuit teams through architecture tradeoffs, implementation options, delivery risk, licensing considerations, and measurable business value.
Identify reusable assets, accelerators, industry patterns, and investment priorities that differentiate Deloitte in the market.
Architect Operate and managed-service capabilities, including observability, reliability engineering, SecOps, FinOps, data governance, and continuous optimization.
Promote platform engineering, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, inner-source practices, GitHub and Azure DevOps automation, and AI-assisted software delivery.
Champion Microsoft independence requirements and permissible-use guidance in internal and client-facing activities.
Build practice capability through architecture reviews, communities of practice, webinars, coaching, and industry-specific solution enablement.

Tactical Responsibilities

Standardize pursuit intake, architecture decisions, estimation, staffing, pricing, delivery planning, and quality reviews through reusable templates and Deloitte artifact standards.
Apply Microsoft independence guidance and coordinate timely reviews for proposed technologies, solution components, demonstrations, and client interactions.
Develop estimates, consumption assumptions, licensing inputs, pricing models, and commercial constructs for cloud, data, AI, application, security, and managed-service engagements.
Coordinate with adjacent ecosystems and practices, including SAP, Oracle, data and analytics, cyber, engineering, industry, and cloud operations, for integrated solutions.
Use Azure DevOps and GitHub for demand tracking, repositories, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, architecture records, code scanning, automated testing, and AI-assisted delivery workflows.
Lead rapid prototypes and R&D for Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI services, and modern application platforms.
Embed Zero Trust, Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Purview, Defender, Sentinel, data residency, accessibility, privacy, and responsible AI requirements into solution designs.
Facilitate architecture reviews and Well-Architected assessments that address reliability, security, cost optimization, operational excellence, performance efficiency, and sustainability.
Measure and continuously improve GSSC outcomes, including pursuit cycle time, estimate quality, asset reuse, architecture risk, delivery readiness, and realized business value.

Required Qualifications

Experienced Consultant 8+ years.
Five or more years of Microsoft cloud architecture, engineering, or delivery experience, including deep Azure expertise.
Demonstrated architecture experience across cloud-native applications, integration, data platforms, identity, networking, security, resiliency, and hybrid or multicloud environments.
Hands-on knowledge of generative and agentic AI patterns using Microsoft Foundry and/or Copilot Studio, including grounding, tools and connectors, orchestration, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI controls.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility, Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Power BI.
Experience with GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform, automated testing, software supply-chain security, and platform engineering.
Knowledge of Microsoft Entra, Defender, Sentinel, Purview, Zero Trust, privacy, data governance, regulatory requirements, and secure AI design.
Ability to apply the Cloud Adoption Framework, Azure Well-Architected Framework, architecture decision records, FinOps practices, and workload assessment methods.
Strong pursuit leadership, estimation, licensing and consumption planning, commercial shaping, executive communication, and cross-functional team-management skills.
Experience developing reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, or industry solutions is preferred.
Deloitte experience and practical knowledge of Microsoft independence requirements are preferred.
Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification is preferred; Azure AI Engineer Associate, Cybersecurity Architect Expert, Power Platform Solution Architect Expert, Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate, or equivalent role-relevant credentials are beneficial.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $141,200-$278,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
OMEGA GESTION DE INVERSIONES SGIIC SA is an independent investment firm focused on alternative assets, with deep specialization in Hedge Funds and Private Equity. The firm offers sophisticated investment solutions designed for clients seeking diversification beyond traditional markets. OMEGA combines rigorous research, risk management, and innovative strategies to deliver long-term value. Team members collaborate in a dynamic, analytical environment where technology and security are critical to safeguarding client assets and data.
Role Description
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading the firm’s information security strategy and operations. The CISO will design, implement, and maintain security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and best practices for financial and alternative investment firms. Day-to-day responsibilities include overseeing cybersecurity monitoring and incident response, managing application and infrastructure security controls, and coordinating business continuity and disaster recovery planning. The CISO will assess and mitigate security risks, lead security audits and compliance reviews, and report on security posture and remediation plans to senior leadership. This role also involves collaborating with technology, operations, and investment teams to ensure secure architecture, vendor risk management, and continuous improvement of security capabilities.
Qualifications

Strong expertise in Information Security Management and Information Security, with experience defining and enforcing security policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
Comprehensive knowledge of Cybersecurity practices, including threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, and security monitoring in financial services or similar regulated environments.
Experience in Application Security, covering secure software development practices, code review, threat modeling, and integration of security controls into applications and platforms.
Proven ability to design and maintain Business Continuity and disaster recovery plans, ensuring resilience of critical systems and services.
Experience with relevant regulatory and industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, financial sector regulations) and risk management methodologies.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders, lead cross-functional initiatives, and present complex security topics to non-technical audiences.
Background in IT infrastructure, cloud security, and identity and access management; familiarity with vendor and third-party risk management.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or equivalent are highly beneficial.
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a remote setting, manage priorities, and drive strategic security initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, our ~17.000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Vice President - Technology
to join our Group at Endress + Hauser Flow India

What is the role about?

The role is to lead the maintenance and technical improvement activities within the manufacturing division. It is also about leading local R+D activities for development of new products or features as well as the production rig manufacturing and retrofit team, executing engineering directives from global headquarters for global applications in 6 factories in Asia, Europe and the Americas.

Lead the maintenance and technical improvement organization, ensuring high equipment uptime, precision, and operational stability.
Guide the retrofit and rig manufacturing team including its department head, to implement upgrades and new builds based on HQ Engineering specifications.
Steer the development team, including its department head, to develop product features and improvements for local markets based on HQ Marketing and R+D specifications.
Drive life cycle management of high-value production equipment.
Ensure alignment with global engineering standards and directives.
Collaborate with peer VPs and global stakeholders to support factory-wide strategic initiatives.
Conduct organizational transformation and continuous improvement programs.
Build and develop high-performing technical teams for new and evolving activities.
Implement and optimize business processes related to maintenance, retrofits, and technical operations.
Promote a culture of safety, innovation, and operational excellence.
Steer the manufacturing engineering team including its department head, to ensure preparedness for capacity planning for volume growth, planning and monitoring of Investment roadmap, ensuring lean production concepts and developing and life cycle management of manufacturing processes
Guide a Team of MES software development team including its department head, to ensure development and implementation of SAP MES applications and digital manufacturing.

What do we expect from you?

Masters in the field of Mechanical or Electrical Engineering with a proven experience of manufacturing / development of complex industrial products and/or industrial engineering.
To be able to lead, Inspire and guide a team of Managers
Have a Proven track record of mastering metrological methods and technologies
Excited to Develop / Manufacture Complex Engineering Products
Experience of Building Teams
Possess a LEAN Six Sigma Black Belt
Lead an Organizational transformation
Experience of Business process management and Communication and collaboration in global networks
Strategic and hands-on leadership style
Strong intercultural communication and collaboration skills.
High resilience and adaptability in dynamic environments.
Passion for innovation and continuous improvement.

Qualification:

Masters / PHD in electrical or mechanical engineering / Master of Business Administration or equivalent and LEAN Six Sigma Black Belt
Min experiences 15 years
>10 years leadership in manufacturing complex industrial products and/or machinery, industrial engineering and / product development
Min. 5 years’ experience in leading managers

Endress+Hauser is amongst world’s best employers with Net Sales of 3.3 billion euros (Over 15,800 employees worldwide)
Over 8,700 patents and patent applications.
We promote lifelong learning with versatile training and further education opportunities, internal knowledge transfer and e-learning.
Immense Opportunities for growth
Global Exposure and International Travel

To apply we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page.

Applications sent to us by E-Mail cannot unfortunately be considered due to Data Privacy considerations.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
About The Role

The Director of
Digital Marketing Technology
is responsible for developing, optimizing, and governing the marketing technology ecosystem that supports demand generation, digital customer experience, product marketing, CRM operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization. This leader will align tools, processes, and integrations to accelerate growth for a multi-brand foodservice and hygiene healthcare portfolio, driving efficiencies that improve marketing performance, sales enablement, and customer engagement.

Location:
This role will be located ON-SITE
at our corporate office in either Lodi, NJ
or Oklahoma City, OK
.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Technology Strategy

Define and maintain the enterprise marketing technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, digital transformation goals, and brand growth plans.
Evaluate emerging platforms and tools in areas such as automation, personalization, analytics, content management, and digital advertising.
Ensure technology scalability across diverse verticals (foodservice, healthcare, hygiene).

Platform Management & Optimization

Own the architecture, implementation, and integration of platforms including:
CRM (e.g., Salesforce)
Marketing automation (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot)
CMS (e.g., WordPress, Sitecore)
DAM, PIM, SEO tools, data enrichment platforms, analytics dashboards, and ERP data connections.

Improve system performance, data quality, workflows, lead management, and reporting insights.

Governance & Data Integrity

Establish governance protocols around data capture, segmentation, privacy compliance (GDPR, HIPAA considerations), and lifecycle.
Partner with IT to ensure security standards and reliable system architecture.
Drive cross-brand data standardization to enable unified reporting.

Sales Enablement

Oversee connectivity between marketing systems and CRM-driven sales workflows.
Automate handoff processes, lead scoring, and intent-based routing.
Provide visibility into funnel health, conversion metrics, and revenue attribution.

Digital Customer Experience

Support digital product catalog experiences, configurators, content syndication, and sample request flows.
Drive personalization strategies across web, email, and channel partner ecosystems.
Enable customer journey mapping and optimization.

Analytics & Performance Insights

Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks for multi-brand performance tracking.
Translate data into recommendations for campaign optimization, product focus, and content strategy.
Partner with Finance and Sales to validate attribution models.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Collaborate with Brand, Product Marketing, Sales, IT, Customer Success, Ecommerce, and Operations.
Train marketing teams on platform capabilities, measurement practices, and automation workflows.
Manage vendor relationships and negotiate platform contracts.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred).
8–12+ years of marketing operations or marketing technology experience, ideally in B2B manufacturing, healthcare, or foodservice industries.
Proven success implementing martech platforms across distributed business units.
Deep understanding of:
Lead lifecycle & scoring
CRM architecture
Multi-touch attribution
Funnel analytics
Data enrichment and governance

Experience managing marketing technology budgets and vendor relationships.
Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.

Preferred Skills

Experience with field sales teams and distributor networks.
Understanding of healthcare compliance and foodservice regulatory landscapes.
Familiarity with ERP integrations and product data management workflows.
Comfort leading change management in evolving organizations.

What You'll Bring

Strategic mindset with hands-on technical proficiency.
Passion for enabling marketers with better tools, data, and insights.
Curiosity for new platforms and evolving digital customer expectations.
Ability to influence without authority across matrixed teams.

Why Join Us

At CFS-style Organizations, You’ll Have An Opportunity To

Shape a modern marketing engine within a growing, multi-brand organization.
Champion digital transformation from strategy to execution.
Help healthcare and foodservice operators deliver safer, cleaner, more efficient experiences to patients, guests, and staff.
Work with collaborative teams who value innovation, accountability, and results.

CFS Brands

Headquarters located in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, CFS BRANDS is a market-leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of commercial foodservice, healthcare, and industrial hygiene products.

CFS BRANDS has maintained its industry-leading position and consistent growth with a strong focus on customer support and satisfaction, product variety and availability, and a unique ability to be a “one-stop shop” solution for a wide range of organizations. CFS BRANDS enjoys this competitive market advantage through its extensive network of brands and global manufacturing and distribution facilities.

CFS BRANDS’s core products include dinnerware, drinkware, professional cookware, industrial hygiene products brushes and cleaning tools, dispensing systems, and healthcare meal service equipment. These products are provided through major distributors customers across the country.

CFS BRANDS became a portfolio company of The Jordan Company (“TJC”), a private equity firm, in 2018. More information on CFS BRANDS can be found at www.cfsbrands.com.

CFS Brands is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age or veteran status. This employer participates in E-Verify. The employer will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s I-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Gemini Security Technical Program Manager, DeepMind
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Zürich, Switzerland; London, UK**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience driving executive level decisions via escalations and de\-escalations.
* Experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders to navigate conflicting priorities and drive aligned outcomes.
* A background that intersects with security and artificial intelligence.
* Passion for process improvement, automation, and increasing efficiency of execution.

**About the job**
-----------------


Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi\-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade\-offs in product development with engineers.  

  

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.



Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high\-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.


We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.
Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $256000 \- $278000 (USD) \+ 20% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with technical leads and product management to solve complex problems.
* Influence Directors, VPs, and external partners to ensure alignment on security outcomes. Drive change management in a fast\-paced climate.
* Develop and leverage a deep technical understanding of GDM’s models, products, and systems to drive cutting edge projects on security initiatives. Translate complex technical requirements into plans of action, and drive them to completion.
* Help set organizational strategy in a dynamic, highly adaptable environment.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-disciplinary teams and multiple concurrent task orders.
* Strong knowledge of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), USACE practices, and applicable codes/standards.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills.
* Proficiency in project management tools and USACE RMS.
* Ability to obtain and maintain additional security clearances as required by specific task orders.
* Commitment to maintaining a safety\-minded management team and culture.
* Completion of USACE Construction Quality Management for Contractors course (within last 5 years)

* Active TS/SCI clearance

jobs.description:
**DEPARTMENT:** Information Services




**POSITION:** Director of Information Technology




**SUPERVISOR:** Vice President of Human Resources and Information Technology/Director of Information Services


The Director is responsible for general oversight under the guidance of senior leadership. The Director is responsible for the design, implementation, and maintenance of the healthcare center's core infrastructure equipment and systems. The role involves ensuring the stability, integrity, and security of in\-house voice, data, video, wired and wireless network infrastructure. This role may require availability after hours as needed for network/system maintenance, emergencies, or to respond to cybersecurity incidents.

* Manage and coordinate all IT\-related matters including systems integration, data, wireless communications, mobile technology, telephony, security, and computer hardware and software.
* Oversee the administration and maintenance of computer stations and software for company and clinical operations, ensuring all systems are compliant with health industry regulations such as HIPAA and HITECH.
* Develop and implement network maintenance and growth plans. Oversee the administration of the company's all networks.
* Develop and enforce policy and procedures to ensure the protection of the IT assets and the integrity, security and privacy of information entrusted to or maintained by the organization.
* Manage IT staff, under the guidance of senior management which includes hiring, training, guidance, and discipline. Ensure high team morale through effective communication and timely issue resolution.
* Conduct routine system audits to ensure compliance with the organization's established standards, policies, and configuration guidelines.
* Maintain knowledge of evolving trends in IT infrastructure and cybersecurity and apply new technologies where applicable.
* Create and manage a disaster recovery plan and respond to all cybersecurity breaches.
* Develop a technical process improvement framework to optimize systems, networks, and infrastructure for better efficiency and performance.
* Oversee the development and enhancement of systems, networks, and integrating new systems with those existing.
* Ensure that networks, systems, and data availability meet business continuity requirements.
* Monitor and analyze system logs to identify potential issues with computer systems, networks, and applications.
* Spearhead troubleshooting, systems backups, archiving, incident response, and disaster recovery, providing expert support when necessary.
* Collaborate with senior management as it pertains to relationship management of vendors and support staff that provide hardware, software, system, network, cybersecurity, and solutions.
* Oversee large scale IT projects such as upgrades and deployments, where necessary. Represent the IT department in coordination with project leaders from other departments and divisions.
* Evaluate potential cybersecurity breaches, coordinate incident response, and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure clear communication with all parties.
* Assist senior management with budgetary planning for the IT department.
* Perform any other duties as assigned.




This role requires the ability to prioritize tasks effectively in a fast\-paced environment, strong customer service skills, and a willingness to explore and adopt new technologies that enhance institutional efficiency. The incumbent must demonstrate strong technical skills in network and systems engineering, along with an in\-depth understanding of cybersecurity principles and best practices.




The role should be carried out according to the highest ethical and moral standards, in adherence to the facility’s corporate compliance plan and all applicable laws. The incumbent must adhere to the facility’s confidentiality statement in accessing and safeguarding protected health information (PHI/ePHI) of residents and employees, as necessary to perform job duties.




Dynamic, hands\-on Director of Information Technology to provide technical expertise and leadership in the areas of network, systems, and cybersecurity, as well as project management. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing and managing all aspects of our information technology systems and ensuring the seamless operation of our IT infrastructure.




* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field; a master’s degree or relevant certifications (such as CISSP, CISM, PMP) are desirable.
* Minimum of 7 years of experience in IT management, with a focus on network, systems, and cybersecurity; experience in a healthcare environment is preferred.
* Excellent project management skills, with a proven track record of successful IT project implementation.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and manage IT personnel.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with all levels of the organization.
* Proactive and solution\-oriented, with the ability to anticipate and address potential IT issues before they arise.

jobs.title: Chief Information Officer, Optum Serve
jobs.description:
For those who want to invent the future of health care, here's your opportunity. We're going beyond basic care to health programs integrated across the entire continuum of care. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

As the Chief Information Officer (CIO) for Optum Serve, you will serve as a strategic technology executive leading the technology roadmap, engineering, IT operations, and platform capabilities that support our federal government clients. Optum Serve is dedicated to helping federal agencies \- including the Department of War (DoW), Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), and Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) \- deliver world\-class healthcare, administrative services, and advanced technology programs.

  

In this role, you will lead a high\-performing technology organization, navigating complex federal regulatory landscapes, contractual constraints, and stringent security frameworks. You will drive innovation, AI products, leverage cloud solutions, and advanced emerging tools, and ensure operational excellence across mission\-critical healthcare systems that serve millions of military members, veterans, and citizens.

  

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely \* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.


For all hires in the Minneapolis or Washington, D.C. area, you will be required to work in the office a minimum of four days per week.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Manage and orchestrate the entire IT ecosystem that supports the Optum Serve business including driving overarching technology strategy, AI product delivery, and delivery execution for the Optum Serve business, ensuring alignment with federal healthcare goals and enterprise objectives
* Serve as a senior customer facing technology executive advisor, engaging senior federal customers and internal executives on complex, high impact technology challenges
* Provide thought leadership on federal healthcare technology trends, emerging capabilities, and regulatory considerations
* Lead transformation of the Optum Serve technology operating model, continuously improving governance, value delivery, capability ownership, accountability structures, and organizational effectiveness
* Partner with Growth and Strategy leaders to identify emerging market opportunities, shape future capabilities, and ensure technology investment strategies support long\-term growth objectives
* Serve as a strategic advisor on how technology, data, AI, and digital capabilities can create competitive differentiation in federal healthcare markets
* Partner with business executives to establish transparent prioritization frameworks that align technology capacity with Optum Serve's highest\-value strategic, operational, contractual, and customer commitments
* Establish and mature technology capability management processes, including build, buy, partner, and reuse strategies that maximize enterprise assets while accelerating delivery
* Provide enterprise wide technical and strategic advisory leadership influencing growth, modernization, and digital transformation initiatives
* Shape and validate customer aligned technology strategies and solution approaches for capture, proposal, and pre\-sales efforts
* Identify growth opportunities through market intelligence, customer engagement, and strategic advisory insight
* Translate ambiguous and novel customer requirements into scalable, compliant solution architectures leveraging existing enterprise platforms
* Lead executive briefings, industry day engagements, and solution demonstrations as the senior technical authority
* Advise on integration, interoperability, data architecture, and security approaches across platforms and partners
* Navigate and manage strict federal regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and security frameworks (including FISMA, FedRAMP, FAR/DFARS compliance, HIPAA, and NIST guidelines)
* Lead the integration of advanced emerging technologies and enterprise AI tools, setting strategic technology goals, and aligning talent development with key digital competencies to accelerate modernization
* Champion the ethical and compliant use of technology and advanced analytics, embedding transparency, fairness, and strict data governance across the solution development lifecycle
* Strategically leverage AI, data, and cloud capabilities to solve complex operational problems, unlock new program efficiencies, and deliver robust mission value to federal agencies
* Manage enterprise risk and security postures in coordination with the Chief Information Security Officer, ensuring consistent renewal of federal Authorities to Operate (ATOs) and the protection of sensitive data (CUI)
* Oversee multi\-million\-dollar technology budgets, direct contract negotiations, and optimize vendor partnerships to achieve strong SLAs and financial stewardship
* Build, mentor, and inspire a world\-class technology organization, promoting a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer\-centric delivery

  

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 15\+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5\+ years of executive\-level IT management
* 8\+ years of experience leading technology delivery, IT operations, or systems engineering specifically within federal government contracting environments (e.g., DoW, VA, HHS)
* 8\+ years experience advising executive stakeholders and customers on technology strategy, architecture, and modernization
* 5\+ years of experience managing compliance and contract governance constraints, including FAR/DFARS, FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST standards, and HIPAA
* 5\+ years of direct financial responsibility overseeing large\-scale technology portfolio

jobs.title: Director of Technology Systems
jobs.description:
**GATEWAY SERVICE GROUP**

**Director of Technology Systems**  

Shared Services \| Hybrid — St. Louis or Washington, D.C., up to 50% travel  

Reports to: VP, Strategy and Corporate Development  

**$160,000–$180,000 base \+ 20% target bonus \+ equity participation**  

Gateway Service Group is one of the fastest\-growing commercial property services platforms in the country. We have already chosen the systems that will run this company. What we need now is the person who makes them work together — and who holds the vendors delivering them to the standard we set.  

This is not a strategy role looking for someone to pick a stack. It is an ownership role for someone who wants to build one.  

**About Gateway Service Group**  

Gateway Service Group is a growing, private equity\-backed commercial property services platform operating across lot sweeping, day porter, power washing, construction sweeping, and other exterior property service lines, with branches serving St. Louis, Atlanta, Washington, D.C., Dayton, Philadelphia, and Kansas City.  

**Position Overview**  

The Director of Technology Systems owns how our technology platform performs: making the systems we have chosen work together, holding the vendors who deliver them accountable, and turning what comes out of them into visibility the business actually runs on.  

You are not joining a blank page. Our platform decisions are made and several systems are already live; your job is to finish the build, connect it, and get our systems adopted and talking to each other across every branch and every business we acquire.  

It is also a role that reaches across the whole company. Operations, finance, sales, and HR all depend on these systems, and none of them report to you. Credibility does the work that authority cannot — you earn it by making things work, and you keep it by being straight about what is not working yet.  

You will work closely with our sponsor’s technical operating partner, who continues to lead long\-range architecture and cybersecurity, so you are not carrying the strategy alone. And there is room to grow here: we are hiring at Director level for someone who will own more over time as the platform scales.  

**Key Responsibilities*** **Own the integration program —** serve as the internal accountability owner for the integration between our ERP and our field service platform — holding milestones, vendor performance, and cross\-functional coordination on schedule, with a 12\-month execution plan approved by executive leadership within 90 days of start
* **Drive the selected stack into every branch —** complete our ERP, billing, and field service rollouts across all locations, and carry the HRIS implementation — already well in flight by the time you arrive — through go\-live and adoption
* **Deliver the reporting layer —** the three to five executive KPIs the business runs on, plus recurring versus non\-recurring revenue and gross margin by service line by location, built off the operating platforms where the data already lives
* **Own vendor and MSP relationships —** contract oversight, SLA accountability, and licensing across the technology portfolio — including handling first\-level triage internally before escalating outward, and holding implementation partners to the dates they committed to
* **Execute IT controls and access governance —** including segregation\-of\-duties remediation, working through our managed service provider and alongside finance
* **Support systems work on acquisitions —** our integrations team runs each deal; your job is to make sure no integration milestone waits on systems, vendor scheduling, or data capacity
* **Support compliance\-driven technology needs —** including fleet telematics and DOT reporting, contractor prequalification portals, and payroll and HRIS data integrity
* **Put AI to practical use —** identify and implement AI\-powered tools that automate real workflows, along with the governance and usage standards to deploy them responsibly
* **Manage the technology budget —** report rollout progress and vendor performance to executive leadership regularly, and build institutional capability so that no system depends on one person’s knowledge — including your own

**Who You Are*** **Player\-coach:** you design the plan and execute it personally — equally comfortable presenting a roadmap in the boardroom and configuring a system the next morning in the field at our local branches
* **Builder:** you have built integrations and reporting systems from scratch, and you know what it takes to go from zero to operational in a resource\-constrained environment
* **Owner:** when something breaks, you find out about it before anyone has to tell you. When a vendor slips or an integration breaks, you own it to resolution rather than relaying the vendor’s excuse, and you surface problems to leadership early rather than after they compound
* **Communicator:** you explain complex technology decisions in plain language, and you approach non\-technical colleagues with patience and clarity — whether they run a branch or sit on the leadership team
* **Resourceful:** you do not default to needing more headcount when there is a gap — you find a way with what you have, then build the system that prevents the gap from coming back
* **Coachable:** you will work with a technical operating partner and an executive team who will challenge you, and you get curious rather than defensive when someone tells you that you are wrong
* **Dependable and team\-first:** crews get paid on time because the systems work. You show up the same way for the high\-visibility work and the unglamorous implementation detail, you share what you know freely, and you never let the systems live only in your head

**Required Qualifications*** Eight or more years of progressive enterprise technology, business systems, or technical program management experience, with increasing ownership over time
* At least one ERP or field servic

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Program Protection
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE**



The Anti\-Tamper (AT) team is hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive security on the next generation of autonomous vehicles. You will own complex programs across the AT portfolio from strategy to rollout — partnering daily with infrastructure, platform, and product teams across the company, while building the metrics and reporting that keep leadership informed on program health. This is a hands\-on, builder role. You should be comfortable reading architecture diagrams, pushing back on vague requirements, and turning security goals into shipped outcomes.


### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* **Ensure Overall Success:** Drive the successful execution of AT programs, ensuring defined requirements are met, stay on schedule, and align with budget.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Own project deliverables and provide regular status updates to internal stakeholders.
* **Program Execution:** Lead execution across project tasks and work plans, partnering closely with senior leadership and engineering. Operate with a high degree of ownership and independent judgment. Serve as a trusted partner to our AT teams.
* **Technical Coordination:** Develop a working understanding of AT architectures and their implementations. Coordinate across the portfolio to identify and fill technical gaps. Gather and analyze metrics to identify areas for improvement and track the impact of new initiatives. Maintain a clear picture of program or process health that can be communicated to stakeholders.
* **Project Coordination:** Define project scope and track changes. Identify, document, and monitor project risks. Maintain and update project schedules, action items, and documentation.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Act as a point of contact for internal teams, gathering requirements and feedback. Represent the services and technical capabilities of the AT team to business stakeholders.

### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in a technical field like Computer Science, Information Systems, OR a degree in a related field with a demonstrated passion for weapon system security.
* 4\+ years of program and project management experience within a technology environment managing multiple concurrent workstreams.
* 5\+ years of experience in engineering or other related technical disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze technical data, build metrics, and use them to drive decisions and track program and project health.
* Experience working directly with technical teams to translate both program and business requirements into actionable project plans.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent organizational skills with a high detail orientation and commitment to quality.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Occasional travel to other company sites may be required, up to 10% of the time.
* Able to obtain and maintain a US Secret Clearance.

### **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Project management certification (e.g., PMP, CompTIA Project\+, CAPM).
* Hands\-on experience with project management and collaboration tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet).
* Background as an AT engineer with expertise in Anti\-Tamper methodologies for protecting critical program information
* Experience standing up or maturing an AT team and portfolio at a high\-growth company


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

  


### **Benefits**



At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.*

  



### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams**



Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.



To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:


* **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
* **Please always verify communications:**
	+ Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address.
	+ Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly iden

**Title:**


Technical Program Manager
***Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR!***


KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high\-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.

  

  

**Why Join Us?**


* **Innovative Projects:** KBR’s work is at the forefront of engineering, logistics, operations, science, program management, mission IT and cybersecurity solutions.
* **Collaborative Environment:** Be part of a dynamic team that thrives on collaboration and innovation, fostering a supportive and intellectually stimulating workplace.
* **Impactful Work:** Your contributions will be pivotal in designing and optimizing defense systems that ensure national security and shape the future of space defense.
  

  

**Position Summary:**


KBR, Inc. is seeking a highly capable technical program manager to join our team in Dayton, OH (on\-site). This role supports the Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE) Group in the development, implementation, and proliferation of mission system Government Reference Architectures (GRAs). These GRAs provide the backbone for enabling advanced sensor capability for emerging and legacy systems across the Air Force, other component services, and international partners. This position serves as a technical program manager performing cost, schedule, performance, and risk management for various contractual activities conducting open system architecture maturation, model\-based systems engineering, software development, and system verification \& validation. * **Deliver:** Process owner supporting Agile development of Government Reference Architectures and standards focused on delivering easy to use products and services supporting multiple customers.
* **Perform:** Support the Government customer in developing tactical execution plans based on high\-level strategic guidance. Utilize agile management processes to lead an industry consortium in the execution of those plans.
* **Gap Analysis \& Risk Identification:** Based on identified system capability gaps, system requirements, and stakeholder feedback, formulate and implement executable program strategies that deliver high\-quality open architecture products. Identify and define suitable risk mitigation plans to address program and/or technical issues.

  

**Work Environment:**


* **Location:** Onsite
* **Travel Requirements:** 0\-10%
* **Working Hours:** Standard – Core hours 0900 \- 1500
  

  

**Qualifications:**


**Required:**


* Bachelor of Science is a technical field.
* Active Top Secret clearance.
* 3\+ years in technical execution.
* 10\+ years of technical program management.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to form strong relationships with team members, customers, and other Government partners.
* Strong technical proficiency with a willingness/ability to learn about mission system software architectures.
* Work with a team of Government and industry SMEs to ensure that programmatic and technical objectives are met.
* Ability to own responsibility for deliverables, cost, and schedule.
* Ability to manage workload of simultaneous tasking in a fast paced, high\-demand environment.
* Personality for a consensus building among multiple stakeholders with competing equities.
  

  

**Desired:**


* 10\+ years in technical execution in a software\-related discipline.
* 7\+ years of Government acquisition program management
* 3\+ years working in Special Access environments
* Familiarity with Agile software development, CI/CD pipelines, and practices.
* Familiarity with existing DoD open architectures and standards including Agile Mission Suite (AMS), Open Mission Systems (OMS), Universal Command \& Control Interface (UCI), or related open architectures.
  

  

**Ready to Make a Difference?**


If you’re excited about making a significant impact in the field of space defense and working on projects that matter, we encourage you to apply and join our team at KBR. Let's shape the future together.

jobs.description:
Company Description

About M3:
A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Vice President, Technology and Product
to join MDLinx
, an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

MDLinx Mission: Transform Omnichannel from Message Delivery to Belief Engineering

MDLinx is on the path to transform its business and product line-up from endemic to omnichannel engagement model, aiming at fulfilling the promise of true omnichannel approach to pharmaceutical brand promotion – “right message to the right physician at the right time on the right channel”. Our goal is to provide pharmaceutical brands with best-in-class personalized HCP engagement programs across the wider media ecosystem, designed to accelerate disease state and brand knowledge penetration, lead generation, and customer conversion. Our ambition is to leverage an omnichannel approach to establish a new philosophy for physician engagement, shifting from delivery to belief engineering.

Job Description

Strategic Leadership

Define and execute the technology roadmap with a focus on AI-driven personalization and content intelligence.
Champion rapid prototyping and experimentation culture across engineering and product teams
Partner with Product, Editorial, Sales, and Marketing teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Lead AI/ML initiatives for content curation, recommendation engines, and predictive physician engagement.
Establish an experimentation framework with an A/B testing infrastructure and data-driven decision-making.
Drive innovation sprints and hackathons to accelerate the development of new features.

Platform & Architecture

Build robust community platforms enabling peer-to-peer engagement among healthcare professionals.
Develop a comprehensive MarTech stack integrating CDP, marketing automation, and omnichannel orchestration.
Architect first-party data infrastructure to capture, unify, and activate physician behavioral signals
Design scalable APIs and integration layers for pharmaceutical partner platforms and data exchanges.
Implement real-time personalization engines leveraging machine learning and behavioral targeting.
Create a modular, composable architecture supporting rapid feature deployment and experimentation.
Ensure platform reliability, security, and compliance with healthcare industry standards (HIPAA, etc.)

Team Development & Management

Build and scale a high-performing engineering organization embracing experimentation and innovation.
Foster a culture of rapid prototyping, fail-fast mentality, and continuous learning.
Establish innovation time (20% projects) and regular hackathons for creative exploration.
Implement agile development with emphasis on quick iterations and the MVP approaches.
Create cross-functional pods combining engineering, data science, and growth teams.
Partner with HR on talent acquisition, focusing on AI/ML and growth engineering expertise.

Data & Analytics

Build a comprehensive first-party data strategy to create a competitive advantage in physician engagement.
Develop unified physician profiles aggregating behavioral, preference, and interaction data across touchpoints.
Implement a customer data platform (CDP) for real-time audience segmentation and activation.
Create data clean rooms for secure collaboration with a pharmaceutical partners.
Design privacy-first architecture supporting targeted advertising without third-party cookies.
Build predictive models for content affinity, engagement propensity, and lifetime value.

AI & Innovation

Lead AI transformation with a focus on generative AI for content creation and summarization.
Implement LLMs for automated medical literature analysis and insight extraction.
Develop an experimentation platform that enables the rapid testing of new features and algorithms.
Create an innovation lab for exploring emerging technologies (voice interfaces, AR/VR, etc.)
Build ML pipelines for automated content tagging, classification, and knowledge graphs.
Foster a fail-fast mentality with a structured approach to proof-of-concepts and MVPs.

Community & Engagement

Design and implement features for the physician community, enabling peer collaboration and knowledge sharing.
Build social layers, including discussion forums, case studies, and peer review systems, to foster a collaborative environment.
Develop gamification strategies to increase engagement and platform stickiness.
Create user-generated content platforms with moderation and quality control systems.
Implement social proof mechanisms (ratings, reviews, endorsements) for content and CME programs.
Build referral and advocacy programs leveraging network effects.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

Evaluate and integrate best-in-class MarTech vendors across the marketing technology stack.
Build strategic partnerships with AI/ML platform providers and data enrichment services.
Manage relationships with advertising technology partners for programmatic capabilities.
Collaborate with M3 global technology teams on shared AI initiatives and data strategies.
Present the technology strategy and experimentation results to the board and executive stakeholders.
Optimize technology spend with a focus on ROI from rapid prototyping and MVP validation.

Qualifications

Experience

7+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, with at least 3 years managing engineering teams.
Proven track record in digital publishing, content management, or healthcare technology sectors.
Experience scaling platforms serving millions of users with high availability requirements.
Demonstrated success in AI/ML implementation and rapid prototyping initiatives.
Background in building experimentation frameworks and data-driven product development.
Track record in community platform development and user-generated content systems.

Technical Expertise

Deep understanding of AI/ML platforms, LLMs, and generative AI applications.
Experience with MarTech ecosystems (CDPs, DMPs, marketing automation, attribution).
Proficiency in building community platforms and user-generated content systems.
Strong background in experimentation platforms and feature flagging systems.
Knowledge of first-party data strategies, identity resolution, and privacy-compliant targeting.
Experience with real-time personalization, recommendation engines, and predictive analytics.
Familiarity with modern cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and event-driven architectures.

Leadership Skills

Strategic vision balanced with hands-on experimentation and a rapid iteration mindset.
Strong advocate for data-driven decision making and hypothesis-driven development.
Ability to build and champion a test-and-learn culture across the organization.
Excellent communication skills for engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience driving growth through technical innovation and rapid market testing.
Track record of building high-velocity engineering teams focused on business impact.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building professional communities or social platforms in healthcare/medical sectors.
Background in programmatic advertising, ad tech, and yield optimization.
Knowledge of Customer Data Platforms (Segment, mParticle, Adobe Experience Platform).
Experience with rapid prototyping methodologies (Design Sprints, Lean Startup).
Track record implementing generative AI in production environments.
Familiarity with healthcare data interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).
Experience with growth engineering and conversion rate optimization.
Background in building developer ecosystems and API marketplaces.
Previous experience in private equity portfolio companies or high-growth environments.

Benefits

Additional Information

A career opportunity with M3USA offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

Health and Dental
Life, Accident and Disability Insurance
Prescription Plan
Flexible Spending Account
401k Plan and Match
Paid Holidays and Vacation
Sick Days and Personal Day

Executive Vice President of Information Technology (EVP IT)
I. Position Overview

The Executive Vice President of Information Technology is responsible for formulating and executing the enterprise's overall IT strategy, overseeing IT infrastructure, enterprise applications, information security, data and analytics, cloud computing, digital transformation, IT operations, and technical service systems.

This role provides technical support for business growth, operational efficiency, digital transformation, and strategic development by building a stable, secure, scalable, and efficient IT ecosystem. The EVP IT typically leads a global or group-level IT organization and collaborates with the CEO, CIO, CTO, and various business units to drive the implementation of the enterprise's technology strategy.

II. Key Responsibilities
1. Enterprise IT Strategy
Formulate medium- to long-term IT development strategies aligned with the company's overall business strategy.
Establish IT technical architecture, investment plans, and roadmaps for key technology development.
Continuously adjust IT strategy and technology resource allocation based on business growth and market changes.
Provide IT strategic recommendations to the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management.
2. IT Infrastructure and Technical Architecture
Oversee IT infrastructure systems, including data centers, networks, servers, storage, and endpoints.
Establish a stable, scalable, and highly available enterprise technical architecture.
Drive the adoption of cloud computing, hybrid cloud solutions, and infrastructure modernization.
Continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of IT infrastructure.
3. Enterprise Applications and System Management
Oversee core enterprise application systems, including ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and supply chain management.
Drive the integration, upgrading, and lifecycle management of enterprise application systems.
Establish unified standards for system management, access control, and technical operations.
Ensure the stable operation of critical business systems and support business growth.
4. Information Security and IT Risk Management
Establish enterprise information security strategies, governance frameworks, and security management mechanisms.
Oversee cybersecurity, identity authentication, access control, data security, and endpoint security.
Establish systems for IT risk identification, assessment, monitoring, and emergency response.
Collaborate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams to meet relevant regulatory requirements.
5. Data and Information Management
Drive the development of enterprise data governance, data architecture, and data standard systems.
Enhance data quality, data availability, and cross-departmental data collaboration capabilities. Support business intelligence, data analytics, and data-driven decision-making.
Drive the continuous upgrading of enterprise data platforms and analytical capabilities.
6. Digital Transformation
Formulate the enterprise digital transformation roadmap and drive the implementation of key projects.
Drive the digitization, automation, and intelligentization of business processes.
Introduce new technologies—such as cloud computing, AI, and automation—to improve business efficiency.
Evaluate the business value and return on investment (ROI) of digital projects.
7. IT Operations and Service Management
Establish a global or group-level IT operations management system.
Oversee IT service desks, technical support, system maintenance, and infrastructure operations.
Establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and IT service performance management mechanisms.
Continuously optimize IT service quality, response times, and operational efficiency.
8. IT Project and Technology Investment Management
Coordinate major enterprise IT projects and technology investment portfolios.
Manage IT budgets, resources, vendors, and project priorities.
Manage costs, schedules, quality, and risks for large-scale technology projects.
Ensure IT investments align with corporate strategy and business value.
9. Technology Vendor and Partner Management
Manage key IT vendors, cloud service providers, software vendors, and technology partners.
Establish systems for vendor selection, evaluation, performance management, and contract management.
Drive cost optimization in technology procurement and the integration of vendor resources.
Manage major technology outsourcing and strategic technology partnership projects.
10. IT Organization and Talent Management
Establish an efficient global IT organizational structure and talent development system.
Oversee the recruitment, development, and succession planning for the IT senior management team and key technical talent.
Establish performance management and career development mechanisms for technical talent.
Cultivate core capabilities in areas such as security, data, cloud computing, digitization, and enterprise architecture.
11. Business-Technology Collaboration
Collaborate with business units to identify opportunities for technology-driven growth and efficiency improvements.
Foster collaboration across IT, product, operations, finance, supply chain, and sales departments.
Ensure technology solutions meet business requirements.
Establish coordination mechanisms between business requirements, technical development, and IT operations.
12. Technology Governance and Executive Strategic Support
Establish enterprise IT governance, technology standards, and decision-making mechanisms.
Report on IT operations and technology strategy to the CEO, the Board of Directors, and senior management. Periodically assess technical risks, IT investment returns, and digitalization outcomes.
Participate in decision-making regarding major corporate investments, M&A, business expansion, and strategic transformations.
III. Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.
Extensive experience in IT management, information technology management, or digital transformation within large enterprises.
Experience in corporate IT strategy, technical architecture, and IT operations management.
Familiarity with cloud computing, enterprise applications, network infrastructure, information security, and data management frameworks.
Experience managing large-scale IT projects, technology investments, and digital transformation initiatives.
Competence in information security, IT risk management, data governance, and technology compliance.
Experience managing cross-departmental, cross-regional, or global IT organizations.
Experience managing IT budgets, vendors, and technology partners.
Strong capabilities in strategic planning, business analysis, and technical decision-making.
MBA, Master’s degree in Information Technology or Computer Science, or other relevant advanced degrees preferred.

jobs.title: Customer Experience, Program Manager | West Region
jobs.description:
**Career\-defining. Life\-changing.**


At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

**About This Role:**


The Customer Experience team is responsible for partnering both internally and externally, including the sales and commercial teams, as well as key stakeholders at large health systems, to design and execute solutions that improve efficiency and outcomes.

**What You Will Do**

* Ability to perform the role effectively for an average of 6 opportunities concurrently.
* Support customer clinical, operational, and financial goals via designing customer journeys to drive adoption of the Zio Service.
* Align with brand priorities to ensure the customer experience (CX) is streamlined, personalized, and optimized.
* Responsible for creating and leading end\-to\-end customer experience strategy and differentiated solutions informed by insights, analytics, and best practices.
* Differentiate iRhythm as a trusted partner in ambulatory cardiac monitoring through the creation of operational efficiencies and standardization of care for patients with cardiac arrhythmias.
* Partner with key stakeholders (Director \+ VP of Cardiovascular Service Line, Population Health, Chief of Cardiology \+ EP, etc.) within large health systems to align on goals and success metrics of cardiac programs, identify challenges with the current cardiac monitoring program, and recommend solutions that enable health systems to optimize their program
* Leverage career experience and iRhythm tools to create standardized, reproducible experiences for customer engagements
* Collaborate closely with CX Senior Manager peers, with iRhythm area sales leadership and cross\-functional team members such as EHR Integration Managers, Key Account Managers, Revenue Cycle Billing Managers, Clinical Operations and Customer Service to effectively meet the needs of our customers and drive adoption of the Zio service.
* Accountable to prioritizing work that meets the needs of iRhythm business goals
* Held accountable to performance metrics that demonstrate physician adoption across large health systems, contributing to the health of IRTCs business
* Strategically partner with the geographic sales team to understand their business plan, and how you can best support them, impacting deep \+ broad penetration of their large health systems

**What We Need To See**
-----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree preferred:
* Minimum of 6 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years of experience in a similar role and a Master’s degree.
* Experience in device or clinical sales working with large health systems in a consultative capacity preferred, or experience working in healthcare in process improvement, cardiovascular leadership, or clinical degree preferred
* Key attributes: Ability to influence across teams with strong teamwork and collaboration; ability to quickly build trust with sales team, cross\-functional partners, and customers as a strategic partner. Willingness to be flexible to the needs of IRTCs business goals, ability to quickly onboard and execute within role within 3\-6 months
* Strong communication and presentation skills
* Ability to quickly analyze data to glean insights impactful to making recommendations to both sales partners and customers
* Demonstrated ability to adapt quickly and deliver on strong performance during times of ambiguity and complexity
* Strong understanding of the healthcare landscape and experience in cardiology preferred
* Ability to multi\-task and prioritize in a fast\-paced environment
* Proficiency with tools commonly used in a business environment including customer relationship management (Salesforce), Microsoft Office (Visio)
* Must be able to travel up to 50%.

**Location:** Remote – National US

**Location:**


Remote \- US
Actual compensation may vary depending on job\-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

**Estimated Pay Range**


$115,000\.00 \- $149,000\.00

We welcome and celebrate people of all backgrounds, experiences, skills, and perspectives. iRhythm Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
