jobs.title: Payer Back Office Strategy / Technology / Operations Consultant, Senior Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

As a Payer Back Office Strategy / Technology / Operations Consultant, Senior Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming health services operations within our Business & Supply Chain Operations network. You will engage directly with clients, offering strategic guidance and innovative solutions to modernize payer systems. Your work will focus on optimizing processes and driving operational improvements, leveraging your skills to deliver impactful results.

As a Senior Manager, you will lead large projects, applying sound judgment and strategic advising to navigate complex challenges. You will motivate and coach teams, fostering a diverse and inclusive environment that contributes to the firm's success. Your role involves crafting clear, impactful messages and validating outcomes with clients, confirming that their feedback is integrated into project strategies. You will deepen your professional skills, staying relevant in the ever-evolving landscape of health services operations.

In this role at PwC, you will be part of our Operations practice, where you will drive results and maintain operational excellence. Your ability to develop high-performing teams and your commitment to excellence will be crucial in delivering quality outcomes for our clients.

Responsibilities

Leading strategic initiatives in payer back office operations to drive modernization and efficiency
Guiding teams in the development and implementation of operations strategies tailored to health services clients
Utilizing analytical thinking and business data analytics to optimize operational processes and performance metrics
Building relationships with stakeholders to facilitate effective communication and engagement
Developing and executing change management plans to support business transformation efforts
Promoting operational excellence through process improvement and optimization techniques
Conducting market research and operating effectiveness reviews to identify opportunities for service delivery model enhancements
Coaching teams in logistics management and operations support to achieve service excellence
Applying strategic questioning and storytelling to convey impactful messages and drive decision-making
Validating quality standards implementation to maintain compliance and operational integrity

What You Must Have

At least a Bachelor's degree
At least 8 years of experience

What Sets You Apart

Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Actuarial Science, Analytics/Data Science, Business Administration/Management, Computer Science/Information Systems, Economics, Engineering, Finance, Government/Public Policy, Health Administration/Public Health, Mathematics/Statistics, Operations/Supply Chain, Organizational Management/Behavior, Risk Management/Insurance
Demonstrating advanced skills in operations strategy and management consulting
Utilizing business data analytics to drive operational excellence
Leading change management initiatives in health services sector
Innovating process improvement and optimization strategies
Engaging stakeholders through strategic questioning and storytelling
Applying logistics management to enhance service delivery models

The salary range for this position is: $124,000 - $280,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. All hired individuals are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. PwC offers a wide range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more. To view our benefits at a glance, please visit the following link: https://pwc.to/benefits-at-a-glance

As PwC is an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at PwC without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity); age; disability; genetic information (including family medical history); veteran, marital, or citizenship status; or, any other status protected by law. 

PwC does not intend to hire experienced or entry level job seekers who will need, now or in the future, PwC sponsorship through the H-1B lottery, except as set forth within the following policy: https://pwc.to/H-1B-Lottery-Policy.

Learn more about how we work: https://pwc.to/how-we-work

For only those qualified applicants that are impacted by the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, San Diego County Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable, arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with these laws. At PwC, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

jobs.description:
At Recor Medical, we are pioneering Ultrasound Renal Denervation (uRDN) therapy to treat hypertension, the leading cardiovascular risk factor in the world. With our Paradise™ uRDN System, we’re on a mission to provide the millions of people who suffer from hypertension with a non-drug and minimally invasive option to lower their blood pressure. Join us on our journey and make a meaningful impact on the lives of people around the globe.

Position Summary

The IT Program Manager owns how IT connects with the rest of Recor Medical. The role holds strategic ownership of the company intranet and IT communication tools including the IT Department Newsletter. This role establishes measurable outcomes for IT communications and training, including reach, engagement, comprehension, completion, and adoption. This position provides project management leadership for cross-functional system implementations, internally organizing each project from initiation through go-live. The role is also accountable for ensuring user-facing and post-implementation training is created by the appropriate subject matter experts, embedded into every implementation as a required workstream.

Responsibilities

Holds strategic ownership of the company intranet — information architecture, governance, content strategy, and editorial standards across IT-published surfaces.
Owns the IT Department Newsletter end-to-end, including editorial calendar, contributor management, voice, and cadence.
Serves as the accountable owner for the wording, timing, and channel of IT-driven change and policy communications.
Establishes and tracks measurable outcomes for IT communications (reach, engagement, comprehension) and ties results to adoption outcomes and business impact.
Partners with Corporate Communications, HR, and Legal where IT messaging intersects with company-wide communications, policy, or compliance requirements.
Provides project management leadership for IT-led system implementations that span multiple business functions (HR, Clinical, Quality, Operations, Finance, etc.).
Runs each project across the full lifecycle: initiation (stakeholder map, success criteria, sponsor sign-off), planning (scope, milestones, RACI, communications and training plan), execution (cross-team cadence), and landing (go-live, post-implementation training, adoption tracking).
Embeds communications and training plans into every implementation as a non-negotiable workstream.
Maintains transparent project status, risk, and decision logs accessible to sponsors and stakeholders.
Conducts post-implementation reviews and applies lessons learned to subsequent projects.
Accountable for ensuring user-facing training is created by the appropriate subject matter expert — governing the process, not authoring the content.
Accountable for ensuring post-implementation training is created by subject matter experts following every system go-live, prior to project closeout.
Tracks training completion and effectiveness; feeds insights back into the next implementation cycle.

Requirements

5+ years of professional experience combining internal communications, SharePoint or intranet administration, training program management, or IT project management.
Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise intranet or internal communications platform; SharePoint Online strongly preferred.
Proven ability to manage cross-functional projects from initiation through go-live, with measurable adoption outcomes.
Strong written and verbal communication — able to translate technical concepts into clear, audience-appropriate language for non-technical end users and executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to hold subject matter experts accountable to deadlines and quality standards without authoring the content directly.
Working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate, and OneDrive.
High degree of organization, self-direction, and discretion handling sensitive and confidential company information.
Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other FDA-regulated industries preferred.

jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.
Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance.
Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience.
Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues.
Set a best-in-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

jobs.title: Director of IT Delivery
jobs.description:
Description
**About the Role**


The Director of IT Delivery is the primary business\-facing leadership role within IT — responsible for translating the priorities of Agronomy, Grain, and Back Office Operations into a funded, sequenced, and realistic IT delivery portfolio. This role owns what gets prioritized, while Director of Technology owns how well the organization can deliver it — the two roles are intentionally separated so neither business urgency nor technical capacity gets steamrolled by the other.

  

  

**What will you do?**


* Own the IT delivery portfolio and roadmap across all business units, ensuring priorities reflect actual business need rather than whoever escalated loudest.


* Serve as the primary point of business engagement for IT — the person each business unit goes to when they need something funded, sequenced, or clarified.


* Translate level of effort into business terms and vice versa — able to look at a piece of IT work and communicate realistic timeline, cost, and tradeoffs to a non\-technical business stakeholder, and translate a business ask back into scoped, sequenced technical work.


* Own delivery tracking and portfolio visibility in Wrike — maintaining the roadmap, project status, and resourcing views that both business stakeholders and IT leadership rely on for decision\-making.


* Act as Scrum Master for IT delivery initiatives — running sprint ceremonies (planning, stand\-ups, retros) where applicable, removing blockers, and keeping delivery teams and Delivery Leads working against a shared, visible cadence rather than ad hoc requests.


* Own change management and UAT coordination for delivery initiatives — ensuring changes hitting production are reviewed, tested, and signed off with clear acceptance criteria before go\-live.


* Manage risk across the delivery portfolio — identifying, tracking, and mitigating risk on in\-flight initiatives, and escalating proactively rather than letting risk surface at delivery.


* Own budget and resourcing for the delivery function — including any third\-party vendors or consultants engaged to support delivery work.


* Lead and coach the Delivery Leads (Agronomy, Grain, Back Office Ops), holding them accountable for business outcomes, not just completed tickets — even though they don't own technical staff directly. Build delivery\-team skill and capacity over time, not just manage day\-to\-day output.


* Partner directly with Director of Technology on a standing, recurring basis to weigh capacity and feasibility before committing work to the roadmap — prioritization decisions are made with technical reality in view, not in isolation.


* Coordinate with Lead Automation Engineer on location\-level and automation\-related priorities specifically, given that role's dual scope as both a working manager and a prioritization partner.


* Work with Manager, Business Systems \& AI / Business Systems Analyst to ensure delivery priorities reflect what AGRIS and other core systems can actually support — preventing commitments that outpace system capability.


* Escalate and resolve prioritization conflicts between business units competing for the same shared technical resources.


* Report portfolio health and delivery risk to the VP of IT as part of overall IT governance.


Publish an organization\-wide monthly update summarizing what IT is working on and has accomplished — giving business stakeholders outside IT regular, digestible visibility into delivery progress without requiring them to track the roadmap directly.


Requirements
**Requirements of Role:**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field; Master's or MBA a plus.


* 5\+ years of experience leading IT delivery, PMO, or business\-relationship\-management functions, ideally in a mid\-size organization (ag, co\-op, manufacturing, or similarly operationally complex industries are a strong fit).


* Working proficiency with Wrike or a comparable project/portfolio management tool, with real experience using it to drive prioritization conversations, not just log status.


* Scrum Master experience or certification (CSM or equivalent) required; PMP or ITIL certification preferred.


* Demonstrated ability to translate technical level\-of\-effort into business\-understandable terms, and business urgency into realistically scoped technical asks — this is arguably the single most important skill for the role.


* Experience managing vendor and third\-party relationships in a delivery context.


* Comfortable operating as a translator between business stakeholders and technical teams without owning the technical work itself.


* ERP\-driven environment experience is a strong plus — familiarity with how a core system like AGRIS shapes what's actually deliverable.


* Track record of holding indirect reports (people who don't report to you on paper) accountable through influence rather than authority.

  

  

**Core Value expectations:**


* Thrive Together


* Integrity in Action


* Grow Forward

  

  

**Physical Demands:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  



  

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to talk or listen. The employee is frequently required to stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms when using equipment. The employee is occasionally required to walk; sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and taste or smell. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, peripheral vision, and depth perception.

jobs.description:
**Introduction**
----------------


**OUR MISSION**


The Maryland Workers' Compensation Commission seeks to secure the equitable and timely administration of the provisions of the Maryland Workers' Compensation law on behalf of its customer, the injured workers, and their employers, by providing an efficient forum for the resolution of individual claims.


**OUR VISION**


The Workers' Compensation Commission envisions a state wherein injured workers and employers are empowered to create an equitable partnership to facilitate prompt and fair resolution of workers' compensation matters.


**ABOUT US**


Together we profoundly touch the lives of so many people and have enormous responsibility to the community by fulfilling our mission of securing equitable and timely administration of the law. The Commission continues to provide services to our constituent partners at a level rarely met throughout the United States. The professionalism, work ethic, and technological acumen manifest in our operations allows us to smoothly and effectively manage the challenges which invariably arise. **Main Purpose of Job**
-----------------------


The Deputy Director serves as the chief operating, supervisory, and financial risk\-management official for the Insurance, Compliance and Reporting Division. The position is responsible for directing the daily operations of the Division; supervising, developing, and evaluating all Division staff assigned to self\-insurance, employer compliance, insurance reporting, and related regulatory programs; and ensuring that the Division’s work is completed accurately, consistently, and within established legal, regulatory, and operational deadlines.  

  

A principal responsibility of the position is the administration and financial oversight of Maryland’s workers’ compensation self\-insurance program. Employers authorized to self\-insure assume direct responsibility for potentially significant and long\-term workers’ compensation liabilities. A deterioration in the financial condition of a self\-insured employer, an inadequately funded claims program, insufficient collateral, or a failure of an employer, surety, financial institution, excess insurance carrier, or third\-party administrator may expose injured workers and the State’s workers’ compensation system to substantial financial and operational risk.  

  

The Deputy Director directs the comprehensive financial, actuarial, claims, insurance, legal\-document, and compliance review of active, financially distressed, terminated, and prospective self\-insured employers. The position evaluates corporate financial condition, liquidity, leverage, profitability, cash flow, debt obligations, creditworthiness, claims reserves, loss development, actuarial projections, excess insurance coverage, security instruments, parental guarantees, organizational changes, and industry\-specific economic conditions. Based on these evaluations, the Deputy Director develops recommendations concerning approval or continuation of self\-insurance authority, security requirements, retention levels, additional financial reporting, corrective actions, and other conditions necessary to protect injured workers and the Commission.  

  

The Deputy Director also manages the operational execution of the Commission’s Employer Compliance Program. This responsibility includes overseeing the identification and investigation of employers that may be operating without required workers’ compensation coverage; coordinating compliance efforts with other governmental agencies; directing notices, referrals, hearing preparation, and follow\-up activity; and ensuring that employers obtain and maintain legally required coverage.  

  

The position exercises substantial independent judgment and delegated authority in resolving complex operational, financial, regulatory, and personnel matters. The Deputy Director develops completed staff work and recommendations for review by the Division Director and presentation to the Commissioners. The position acts for the Director in the Director’s absence on operational matters and represents the Division in meetings with employers, corporate officers, attorneys, actuaries, insurance professionals, financial institutions, governmental officials, contractors, and other stakeholders.  

  

The Deputy Director reports to the Director of the Insurance, Compliance and Reporting Division. The Director establishes Division policy, strategic direction, risk\-governance standards, and final recommendations to the Commission. jobs.title: Chief Information Officer
jobs.description:
Goodwill Greater New York and Northern New Jersey (GWNYNJ) believes that the power of work and sustainable fashion is how we unlock the good in our communities. For over 100 years, we have helped people get jobs, stay employed, and progress in careers across New York and Northern New Jersey. We believe that diversity drives innovation and strengthens our workplace. We are committed to fostering our inclusive environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute fully. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities.
  
  

GOODWILL INDUSTRIES OF GREATER NEW YORK \& NORTHERN NEW JERSEY INC.
  
JOB DESCRIPTION
  
  

**Position Title:** Chief Financial Officer
  
**Location:** Brooklyn, NY
  
**Benefit Classification:** Full\-Time Benefitted
  
**Position Type:** FLSA \- Exempt
  
  

About This Role
  
  

The Chief Information Officer provides functional and strategic leadership, management and operational supervision of information and telecommunication technology. This role builds a way forward for Goodwill NYNJ. Goodwill NYNJ has migrated from an on\-premises data center to the Azure cloud infrastructure, characterized by standardization, uniformity, and best\-in\-class hardware and software, aimed at driving improvements in performance and reliability for our business units. The CIO oversees and manages the complex information technology functions and activities of the organization’s diverse business lines – from personal medical records to retail sales data. The CIO is a change agent for the organization and critical to building its mission impact, while ensuring improved processes and actively controlling expenses. Information Technology touches every aspect of the Retail, Mission Services, TempWork and Administrative divisions, and the CIO must understand the workflows, goals and objectives of the organization to appropriately apply technology to improve and transform processes. We need a leader with a vision for a customer\-centric department that prioritizes continuous improvement and on\-time delivery of value\-adding products and services. The CIO also leads the operational and strategic aspects of Cybersecurity at Goodwill NYNJ. The use and adoption of AI at Goodwill NYNJ is the responsibility of the CIO who drives the implementation and development of Guidelines, policies and procedures related to the use of AI at Goodwill NYNJ ensuring it meets the business needs and adheres to security guidelines and processes.
  
  

The Awesome Things You’ll Do
  
Leadership and Management
  
* Build and lead a culture of agility and adaptability among internal I.T. staff and vendors, to effectively support innovations in tools and processes within business units.
* Create an IT strategy that aligns with Goodwill's strategic direction, which also controls cost, provides scalability and capitalizes on evolving technologies.
* Ensure integration of business processes, technology solutions, data and customer experience to drive capability, innovation, and revenue.
* Identify IT opportunities, costs, risks, and resulting business value for all IT investments.
* Establish and maintain a data\-oriented I.T. department culture that gives easy, useable access to data. Assess department performance, infrastructure performance and recommendations for continuous improvement of I.T. workflows that are used for decision making.
* Manage the implementation, maintenance and modification of dashboards (both new and existing) with the leverage of Business Intelligence software.
* Direct, oversee, and manage the purchasing, design, implementation, and maintenance of information systems to ensure the achievement of tactical and strategic business requirements and objectives. Ensure best in class products that are easy to integrate and have high customer service responsiveness.
* Select, negotiate with, and manage vendors to build effective, results\-oriented partnerships between the vendors and the organization. Establish and implement a process for regularly assessing vendor performance and for holding vendors accountable.
* Work closely with the CFO to identify critical priorities and maintain tight control over spending while meeting the organization’s business needs.
* Lead the development of IT budget, including capital expenses pertaining to technology projects. Develop forecasts for funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials, and supplies. Monitor and approve expenditures.
* Develop and administer IT security strategy, and policies and procedures for network availability, security, and related issues. Ensure overall compliance with mandated standards including HIPAA, PCI, HITECH, and others.
* Manage all IT staff, contractors, and vendors.
* Assume full management responsibility for IT functions and services.
* Plan and supervise the development and delivery of IT\-related training programs for management and technical staff.
* Prepare cost\-benefit analyses for changes in I.T. workflow and systems, find solutions to friction within the organization and enable technology solutions to help reduce costs and improve mission or revenue.


Organizational Support
  
* Understand and internalize the thrift stores and mission strategic and tactical priorities of the organization and develop I.T. workflows and processes that support the achievement of those priorities.
* Develop and maintain an I.T. team and vendor structure that can consistently respond timely and effectively to our internal customers.
* Using Managed Vendor relationships, oversee on\-time and on\-budget delivery of critical software development projects including, modifications to company websites and key applications used by the business units.
* Be clear and transparent in all ways, including build and publish a Service Level Agreement for internal customers and implement a process to ensure that the I.T. team (staff and vendors) is held accountable for meeting those SLA

jobs.title: Director of IT Advertising Operations
jobs.description:
The Director of Advertising Operations leads the IT function that supports Lee Enterprises’ advertising business. The role is accountable for the reliability and direction of advertising platforms, integrations, and technical operations spanning sales and order entry, digital fulfillment, creative and print production, billing and payments, and reporting.
  
The Director leads technical staff, sets priorities across daily support and change initiatives, and serves as a primary IT partner to Advertising leadership. Working with Finance, Sales Enablement, Product, Application Development, Infrastructure, Security, the PMO, and vendors, this position turns business needs into practical technology plans and provides leadership for major implementations and migrations.
  
  

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**  

Directly supervises and develops the platform support analysts and other technical staff assigned to Advertising Operations. Sets individual and team priorities, allocates work, manages performance, plans coverage and succession, and supports staff development.
  
  

**Core Responsibilities:**  

* Own the IT strategy and operational performance of advertising order management, CRM and sales workflows, creative and production systems, digital advertising, payment processing, reporting, and related third\-party platforms.
* Directly lead the platform support analysts and other assigned technical staff; establish priorities, allocate capacity, develop employees, and maintain support coverage and institutional knowledge for critical systems.
* Partner with Advertising and IT leadership to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and a prioritized Jira backlog, balancing operational support, enhancements, and project delivery against available capacity.
* Oversee application support, incident escalation, problem resolution, upgrades, change management, and operational readiness for revenue\- and production\-critical systems.
* Lead the technical and operational aspects of platform implementations and migrations, including requirements, testing, cutover, stabilization, and transition or retirement of legacy systems.
* Oversee integrations and data flows among order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, creative and pagination systems, billing, payments, and reporting; establish priorities for configuration, automation, and enhancements.
* Ensure system changes are tested across connected workflows and validated with business users, including production checks and reconciliation where transactions affect financial records.
* Partner with Finance on advertising billing, accounts receivable, payments, reconciliation, and controls at the points where advertising and financial systems meet.
* Coordinate with development, architecture, infrastructure, security, and service management teams to resolve issues and align platforms with enterprise standards.
* Manage advertising technology vendor relationships, including escalations, implementation commitments, service performance, technical requirements, and product direction.
* Maintain operational documentation, access governance, audit support, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices for advertising systems.
* Use Jira and a regular Agile planning and review cadence to track commitments, completed work, blockers, and dependencies; report delivery progress, system health, risks, and resource needs to IT leadership and business stakeholders. Coordinate timely response to critical issues, including after\-hours escalation when necessary.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**  

* Experience leading enterprise applications and technical teams in a complex, integrated operating environment.
* Ability to direct work across application support, systems analysis, integrations, production technology, and software development disciplines.
* Working knowledge of APIs, data exchanges, automation, vendor\-hosted platforms, and the controls needed to support reliable cross\-system processes.
* Experience leading major implementations, migrations, upgrades, and vendor relationships while balancing ongoing support needs.
* Ability to use Agile practices and Jira to manage a transparent backlog, guide planning and delivery reviews, and communicate progress and technical risks to engineers, vendors, business partners, and senior leaders.
* Advertising, media, order management, CRM, digital fulfillment, payment, or production systems experience preferred; familiarity with Naviga Ad, Adbase, HubSpot, Google Ad Manager, or related platforms is an advantage.


**Education \& Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, business, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* Eight or more years of progressive experience in IT, enterprise applications, business systems, or related work, including at least three years leading technical teams or major technology programs.
* Experience supporting integrated systems in a multi\-location or enterprise environment preferred.


Why Join Us?
  
Lee Enterprises offers competitive wages in a dynamic, interesting work environment with career growth opportunities. We offer an extensive benefit program that can be personalized to your needs. Our benefit program includes medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability, company provided life insurance and supplemental life insurance. In addition, we offer a 401K retirement plan with company match. We also offer generous paid time off to allow the flexibility to balance personal life and work. This includes paid parental leave for new parents.

This role provides enterprise portfolio oversight across IT projects through effective intake management, governance support, resource capacity planning, vendor coordination, risk management, and Executive reporting.  



**Enterprise Partnership and Governance** In support of the Chief Information Officer (CIO), this individual ensures proposed and approved work is clearly defined, strategically aligned, appropriately sequenced, and delivered using consistent PMO standards. Key partnerships and collabroations include leadership within Strategy and Business Development, Operational Finance, IT leadership, CaroMont and CaroMont Medical Group operational leaders, clinical and business stakeholders, project sponsors, vendors, and governance committees.


**Core Capabilities and Organizational Impact** The IT Portfolio Director demonstrates strong leadership, communication, facilitation, analytical thinking, healthcare IT knowledge, and portfolio management discipline. The role balances organizational demand with available IT and Operational capacity; promotes innovation and cross\-functional collaboration; and ensures programs support regulatory standards, organizational goals, and evolving healthcare needs.


**PMO Leadership and Team Development** The Director leads the Portfolio/Program Management Office providing direction and oversight of a team of Program and Project Manager professionals. This includes providing coaching, mentorship, and performance guidance to promote professional growth and high performance across the PMO team.


**Additional Leadership Scope** At the discretion of the Vice President of Information Technology and CIO, this position may also direct and manage additional IT teams, including teams supporting enterprise platforms such as ERP or EHR systems. In this capacity, the Director provides collaborative oversight for the development, adoption, and ongoing optimization of related core systems.


***Qualifications:*****Required Education and Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Project Management, or a related field required. Amazon Robotics (AR) seeks a talented and motivated Sr. Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join the Quality Technology Services (QTS) organization, focused on manufacturing technology platforms. This role owns the program management and delivery of manufacturing execution systems and shop\-floor technology solutions including Tulip (MES platform), Atlas tools, and associated integrations that enable Amazon Robotics' production operations at scale.  

  

The TPM will lead programs that connect manufacturing operations with technology platforms, driving capability build\-out, system implementations, and continuous improvement across Tulip MES, Atlas tools (work instructions, traceability, quality inspection, production dashboards), and their integrations with enterprise systems (ERP, PLM, and supply chain platforms). This is a high\-visibility role requiring strong manufacturing domain expertise, technical program management rigor, and the ability to partner with plant operations, manufacturing engineering, quality, and software teams to deliver solutions that improve throughput, quality, and operator experience on the shop floor.  

  

The ideal candidate brings a passion for manufacturing technology transformation, hands\-on experience with MES platforms and shop\-floor digitization, and the leadership skills to drive cross\-functional alignment between manufacturing operations, IT, quality engineering, and partner technology teams within QTS.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own end\-to\-end program management for Tulip MES and Atlas manufacturing tools from requirements through deployment and operational handoff across Amazon Robotics manufacturing sites.
* Drive the roadmap and capability framework for manufacturing technology solutions: work instructions, production tracking, traceability, quality inspection, and operator\-facing applications.
* Lead requirements design, process mapping, user acceptance testing, and rollout planning for Tulip apps and Atlas tool deployments in collaboration with manufacturing engineering and plant operations.
* Manage integrations between manufacturing execution platforms and boundary systems (ERP/SAP, PLM/Teamcenter, quality systems, data platforms) to ensure end\-to\-end data flow from shop floor to enterprise.

* Coordinate cross\-functionally with QTS engineering, quality, supply chain, and infrastructure teams to define technical requirements and deliver integrated solutions.
* Establish program governance: status reporting, dependency management, risk mitigation, and executive communication — across concurrent manufacturing technology workstreams.
* Drive continuous improvement: measure platform adoption, operator feedback, and production KPIs to iterate on manufacturing technology solutions.

jobs.title: Director of Technology
jobs.description:
**Department:** Technology
  
**Reports to:** Executive Leadership
  
**Location:** Remote (with some on\-site presence at PA facilities)
  
**Type:** Full\-time
  
**Direct Reports:** Information Technology Lead, External vendors and contractors
  
  

About Gordon Sinclair
  
  

Gordon Sinclair is a promotional products supplier and manufacturer with over 35 years of experience bringing award\-winning branded merchandise to market for some of the most recognized companies in the world. We design, source, and produce a curated line of premium lifestyle products: items built to carry a brand, not just a logo.
  
  

The Role
  
  

Gordon Sinclair is looking for its first dedicated technology leader to maximize the return on technology investment. This role will connect technology to business strategy, establish governance across systems and vendors, coordinate work across functions, build the technology team, and ensure it has the processes, priorities, and support to deliver.
  
  

This is not a maintenance role. This is a leadership role. You will own the technology strategy, the vendor relationships, the roadmap, and the cross\-functional coordination. You will manage an existing IT Director and work alongside operational leaders across Sales, Operations, Product Development, and Supply Chain. You will sit on the leadership team with the authority to drive change across the organization.
  
  

The right candidate is someone who builds strong foundations. The first six months are about understanding what exists, documenting, introducing governance, and building trust across the business. You are here to make what exists work, evaluate what should change, and build a roadmap grounded in business outcomes.
  
  

Core Responsibilities
  
  

Technology Strategy and Roadmap
  
  

* Own the technology strategy and create a prioritized 12\-month roadmap aligned to revenue growth and margin improvement goals.
* Evaluate whether current platform decisions are right\-sized for Gordon Sinclair, and recommend changes where justified by usage, cost, and strategic fit.
* Translate business priorities into technology investment decisions and ensure leadership understands the trade\-offs.


Governance and Risk Management
  
  

* Introduce source control, code review, change control, and testing practices across all custom development.
* Implement monitoring and alerting across the integration layer so failures are detected in real time, not after the fact.
* Maintain a dependency map of production scripts, integrations, and data structures to prevent cascading failures during system changes.
* Maintain an infrastructure registry documenting every system, where it lives, who built it, and how to access it.
* Ensure that work done by contractors and IT personnel is documented, and that the company retains full knowledge of what was built.


Vendor and Contractor Management
  
  

* Own all technology vendor relationships with documented scope, deliverables, spend tracking, and accountability.
* Evaluate vendor performance and make build\-vs\-buy recommendations based on business need, not familiarity.
* Assess whether industry\-focused middleware should be retained or brought in\-house to enable greater cost effectiveness, control, and scalability.


Cross\-Functional Process Ownership
  
  

* Implement workflow and project management tooling so that cross\-functional processes live in systems that enforce accountability.
* Bridge the communication gap between technology and business functions by establishing a standing reporting cadence that translates technology work into business language.


Visibility and Reporting
  
  

* Provide leadership with visibility into backlogged work, work in progress, and delivered outcomes.
* Visualize the pipeline of technology work and its business value so investment decisions are grounded in outcomes, not assumptions.
* Identify key points of failure in existing technology and plan remediation proactively, before they become emergencies.
* Track and report on technology’s contribution to business outcomes, including integration success rates, time\-to\-market for new products, and data completeness.


Team Leadership
  
  

* Manage the IT Lead, providing prioritization, direction, and a structured reporting cadence.
* Evaluate staffing needs and make the case for supplemental resources where the workload exceeds capacity.
* Establish cross\-training and documentation practices to reduce key\-person risk.


Industry Integration
  
  

* Assess PromoStandards compliance gaps and create a prioritized implementation plan to support distributor growth and automated order flow.
* Ensure the distributor\-facing technology quality matches the quality of Gordon Sinclair’s products.


Security and Policy
  
  

* Own IT and InfoSec policies surrounding the usage of technology at Gordon Sinclair, including AI.
* Coordinate with managed service providers on ITSM and infrastructure, with clear division of responsibilities.


Required Qualifications
  
  

* 7\+ years in technology leadership roles with direct responsibility for strategy, vendor management, budgets, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Experience with ERP platforms (NetSuite strongly preferred) in a manufacturing or distribution environment.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technology roadmaps and communicate technology outcomes to non\-technical leadership.
* Experience introducing governance practices (change control, source control, code review, monitoring) into growing organizations.
* Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships with accountability for scope, deliverables, and spend.
* Experience managing and developing technical staff.
* Experience managing offshore technical resources.


Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience in the promotional products industry or adjacent B2B distribution/manufacturing sectors.
* Familiarity with PromoStandards,

jobs.title: Compliance Program Manager
jobs.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.


Role Overview
  

The Program Manager, Compliance is a strategic driver of Stord’s operational strength and commercial growth. This role is responsible for scaling enterprise compliance programs across OSHA, EPA, GMP, and adjacent regulatory regimes \- building the infrastructure that enables Stord to operate with confidence, win in the market, and deliver on the compliance commitments that today’s leading brands require from a fulfillment partner. A mature, well\-run compliance program is not just a risk management function at Stord; it is a competitive differentiator that unlocks customer revenue, supports network expansion, and protects the business at scale.
  

  

Reporting to the Director of Health, Safety \& Security, this is an enterprise\-level, network\-wide role that operates at the intersection of compliance, operations, and growth. The Program Manager partners closely with Sales, Customer Success, Operations, and Finance to ensure compliance capabilities are a strength Stord leads with \- enabling the business to pursue regulated customer segments, scale into new markets, and demonstrate the program maturity that top\-tier brands demand. The work product of this role is what the entire organization is built around: scalable written programs, audit frameworks, certification standards, reporting infrastructure, and regulatory intelligence systems that grow stronger as Stord grows.
**What This Role Owns**
=======================

This role owns the enterprise compliance program architecture \- the standards, written programs, audit frameworks, and governance mechanisms that define what ‘compliant’ looks like at every Stord facility. The work product of this role is what the rest of the organization is held accountable to. Specifically:


* Enterprise compliance program design, construction, and ownership across OSHA, EPA, GMP, GDP, DOT, and applicable state and local regulatory frameworks \- building programs from the ground up where gaps exist and elevating inconsistent standards to enterprise\-grade.
* Regulatory intelligence: continuously monitoring rulemaking, agency guidance, and enforcement trends; converting regulatory change into updated enterprise programs before gaps become violations.
* Enterprise audit and inspection framework: designing the internal audit program architecture, defining scope and methodology, and building the tools and cadences that keep the network inspection\-ready \- not conducting site audits, but building the system that governs them.
* Enterprise compliance documentation infrastructure: designing and owning the system of record for all written programs, SOPs, training requirements, certifications, and regulatory correspondence \- the single source of truth for compliance across the network.
* Customer and industry certification programs: GMP, GDP, CTPAT, TAPA, and other regulated operating standards required by Stord’s customer base.
* Regulatory agency relationships: serving as the primary compliance point of contact for OSHA, EPA, and other agencies at the program level.

jobs.title: MKE Program Manager
jobs.description:
Covenant Aviation Security (CAS) is seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead airport security operations at Milwaukee Mitchell International Airport (MKE). This position is accountable for ensuring security operations meet contractual requirements, client expectations, regulatory standards, and company policies and procedures. The Program Manager provides direct oversight of operational performance and workforce management, including staffing, scheduling, training, badging, employee performance, compliance, and administrative functions. The position also serves as a key liaison between CAS and airport, regulatory, law enforcement, and other external stakeholders.
  
Company History
  
Founded in 2002, Covenant Aviation Security (CAS) was established to provide a higher standard of transportation security following the events of September 11, 2001\. CAS pioneered a customer\-focused security model built on a highly trained, professional workforce supported by competitive wages, benefits, and ongoing development.
  
Today, CAS is the largest private contractor providing Screening Partnership Program (SPP) services to the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and an industry leader in aviation security solutions. Through its commitment to safety, compliance, operational excellence, and customer service, CAS provides comprehensive security and screening services for airports, airlines, and government agencies across the United States.
  
Employment Compensation \& Benefits
  
Covenant Aviation Security offers a competitive compensation package, with a targeted compensation range of $60,000 \- $75,000 annually depending on qualifications, experience, and contract requirements.
  
  

In addition, employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package designed to support their health, well\-being, and financial security, including:
  
* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance (effective the first day of the month following sixty (60\) days of continuous employment)
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Company\-Paid Life Insurance
* Voluntary Supplemental Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
* Company\-Furnished Uniforms (where applicable)

Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan provisions and may be modified at the Company's discretion.
  
Essential Functions
  
* Provide leadership and oversight of security operations and subordinate personnel assigned to the MKE contract.

* Ensure compliance with Post Orders, operating procedures, client rules and regulations, Company policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate operational programs, procedures, and workforce performance to ensure mission accomplishment, compliance, service quality, and technical competence.
* Plan and organize the effective use of staffing and operational resources to meet contractual and operational requirements.
* Develop, review, and analyze employee work schedules to ensure appropriate staffing coverage and workforce efficiency.
* Monitor schedule assignments, staffing levels, and workforce availability and make adjustments as operational needs require.
* Assess employee performance and participate in employee selection, promotion, development, and other personnel decisions.

* Foster effective working relationships with CAS employees, Company leadership, the client, and external stakeholders.

* Must be able to distinguish colors in bright and low\-light conditions and have vision correctable to 20/20\.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

Instacart is building a best-in-class Internal Audit function from the ground up, and this role is central to it. This leader would add the structure, rigor, and technical depth required to deliver risk-based IT audit engagements at executive-quality standards.

Reporting directly to the Head of Internal Audit, this Director will own end-to-end IT audit delivery while building the function's technology capability and strategic priorities.

This role is for a seasoned Internal Audit professional who combines deep technical judgment with strong business acumen, excellent communication skills, a collaborative approach, and the drive to build something meaningful.

What You'll Cook Up In Your First Year

Audit Delivery & Reporting

IT audit and advisory engagements are delivered end-to-end with executive-quality standards, clear ownership, and defensible scope.
Independent audit judgment is applied consistently across engagements. Scope is calibrated to actual risk exposure, root cause analysis is rigorous, and conclusions are well-evidenced — not driven by checkbox compliance.
Risk and control frameworks are applied with sound judgment, and findings are translated into clear, actionable narratives that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Hands-on expertise with cloud and data platforms — including AWS, GCP, Datadog, and Okta — is applied to assess controls and design practical, effective solutions across key environments.

Team Leadership & Development

A high-performing audit team is developed through structured coaching, clear expectations, and tailored development plans, with a culture of excellence, continuous learning, and proactive problem-solving taking hold.

AI, Technology & Innovation

AI risk and governance considerations — including GenAI and agentic AI model risk, bias, transparency, and data privacy — are integrated into the audit approach.
AI-enabled tools and data analytics are adopted to expand coverage, improve efficiency, and enhance audit impact.

Tools & Process Improvement

The Workiva platform is fully implemented and administered, anchoring the function's first-time build of a risk-based Internal Audit operating model aligned to IIA Standards.
Controls are streamlined, manual effort is reduced, and operational efficiency across the audit function improves.

Stakeholder Partnerships

Productive relationships are built and maintained with business leaders and cross-functional partners — including Finance, Legal, ERM, Compliance, IT, Engineering, and Security — to implement scalable controls.
This role serves as a trusted advisor across technology and data teams, shaping audit approaches for complex, AI-driven environments.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have Pantry Staples (Minimum Qualifications)

12-15 years of progressive professional experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing IT risk-based audits at a high-growth, global company.
Demonstrated experience building a risk-based Internal Audit function from the ground up, with working knowledge of IIA Standards and the ability to apply them in practice.
Track record of delivering risk-based audits in a fast-paced, agile technology environment with competing priorities and evolving risk landscapes.
Exceptional written communication skills. Able to produce executive-quality audit reports with minimal revision and translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable narratives.
Collaborative, relationship-oriented approach with the ability to influence and partner effectively across all levels of the organization.
Translate deep technical expertise into impactful, actionable insights that resonate with both technical and non-technical audiences.

Optional Garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

CISA, CRISC, or CIA certification. One or more of these designations is strongly preferred for this role.

jobs.description:
For over 70 years, Delrin® has been the trusted choice for engineers who demand high-performance materials. Our acetal homopolymer empowers innovative product design with superior mechanical properties, unmatched machinability, and design flexibility. We provide materials, knowledge, and collaboration to achieve breakthroughs that build a better future.

Delrin® is an engineering plastic/polymer used by our customers for many crucial components in highly engineered and technical applications, largely replacing metal with more efficient and cost-effective solutions that last as long. We have a strong focus on sustainability and produce a portion of our products from 100% bio feedstocks.

Delrin® Job Description

Chief Information Security Officer

Job Description

The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for overseeing the information security needs of the company. You will develop and oversee a comprehensive information security strategy that protects the company from all internal and external threats, while ensuring that the company adheres to all applicable cyber security regulatory, contractual, customer, and audit requirements. You will be required to stay up-to-date on emerging threats and security technologies and partner with the IT, OT, Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and business organizations to implement modern cyber security solutions.

In addition, the CISO will own the company’s cyber security incident response program and prepares the company for potential cyber-attacks through documented response plans, testing, training, and executive tabletop exercises. The CISO is accountable for cyber security strategy, governance, risk management, policies, standards, and oversight. IT (Information Technology), OT (Operational Technology), application, data, and business teams remain responsible for operating their respective systems and implementing security controls in accordance with the company’s cyber security requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement a comprehensive information security strategy aligned with the company’s business objectives, risk tolerance, and IT and OT priorities.
Establish and maintain a global cyber security governance framework covering IT, OT, cloud, network, application, identity, endpoint, and data security.
Ensure that IT and OT security controls adhere to applicable regulatory, contractual, customer, audit, and company requirements.
Own the company’s cyber security risk management program and risk register, including risk identification, treatment, acceptance, remediation, and regular executive reporting.
Own and maintain the company’s cyber security incident response program, including preparation, escalation, communication, investigation, containment, recovery, corrective action, tabletop exercises, and periodic testing.
Oversee continuous security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident triage, and remediation through internal teams, IT and OT organizations, and managed security service providers.
Develop security architecture requirements, policies, standards, and control objectives for IT and OT systems in partnership with IT Infrastructure, Enterprise Applications, Data and Analytics, site OT leadership, and other technology stakeholders.
Provide cyber security governance and guidance for network segmentation, remote access, identity and access management, cloud services, endpoints, applications, data protection, backup protection, and industrial control environments.
Partner with IT Operations, application teams, and site OT teams to ensure security controls are implemented, maintained, monitored, and continuously improved within the systems and networks they operate.
Create, implement, maintain, and enforce IT and OT security policies, protocols, standards, procedures, responsibilities, decision rights, and escalation paths.
Manage IT security personnel and oversee managed security service providers, Security Operations Center services, security vendors, and other external providers, including performance, escalation, control effectiveness, and continuous improvement.
Lead cyber security audit, assessment, and evidence coordination activities, including regulatory audits, IT general controls audits, customer security assessments, internal assessments, external inquiries, and remediation tracking.
Establish and oversee third-party cyber security risk management, including due diligence, risk assessments, contractual requirements, ongoing monitoring, vendor negotiations, and remediation.
Develop and oversee the company’s cyber security awareness and training program, including phishing awareness, employee and contractor training, completion metrics, and education for higher-risk roles.
Develop and manage the cyber security budget, resource plans, investment priorities, metrics, and key risk indicators, and communicate security posture, emerging threats, costs, business value, and risk reduction to executive leadership and appropriate governance bodies.

Ideal Profile

A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security, risk management, or a related field. An MBA or relevant advanced degree is preferable.
A minimum of nine years' experience in risk management, information security, cyber security, IT, OT security, or a related field, including leadership experience.
Knowledge of information security management frameworks, such as ISO/IEC 27001 and NIST.
Experience developing enterprise cyber security strategies, governance frameworks, policies, standards, risk registers, and incident response programs.
Experience working with IT and OT organizations in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Experience overseeing Security Operations Center services, managed security service providers, incident response, vulnerability management, and security remediation.
Experience supporting regulatory, customer, internal, and external cyber security audits and assessments.
Experience with third-party cyber security risk management, customer security assurance, and cyber security contractual requirements.
Outstanding negotiation skills for negotiating contracts and security support services to be rendered.
Excellent understanding of current legislation, regulations, contractual obligations, and industry requirements relevant to our organization.
Excellent project management, risk management, and leadership skills.
Ability to communicate technical cyber security risks in business terms and clearly explain costs, value, risk reduction, and recommended actions to executive leadership.
First-rate written and verbal communication skills.
Based in Wilmington, DE or remote in other locations

We offer: 

An exciting opportunity to make an impact in a dynamic and growth-oriented company.
A competitive remuneration package, including generous benefits.

Our culture is grounded on the foundations of Stewardship, People, Growth, and Excellence, guiding us as we engineer a better future, together.

Stewardship - We embrace stewardship, upholding the safety and wellbeing of our people, our customers and our communities.
People - We empower our people, fostering a culture of respect, empowerment and continuous development.
Growth - We focus on growth, embracing innovation and adaptability to expand possibilities for our customers and our business.
Excellence - We drive excellence, achieving superior results through agile execution and advanced solutions.

Delrin is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We encourage qualified candidates of all backgrounds to apply for this exciting opportunity to join our team and contribute to our continued success.
